people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the founder at the age of her defining deed, 380: on the cone above the rain forest, a slight woman under a spotted-bamboo umbrella, having stopped mid-sentence because rain has begun. She listens to rain fall on the whole forest at once.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened, of a slight woman under an umbrella of spotted bamboo who has stopped speaking mid-sentence and tilted her face up to the first rain. Face: most important, the large umbrella of split bamboo, its ribs covered with oiled paper and the poles spotted brown-purple, fills the top of the frame, and under it her face is turned up and listening. A small, fine-boned, serene face, pale brown, ageless; closed or half-closed pale eyes; thin brows lifted; a small straight nose; lips parted as if the next word is lost. Hair: black, with silver threads, in a plain low knot at the nape held by a slim bronze pin. Body: slight, narrow, still. Clothing: a long black oiled-silk rain cloak over a grey inner robe of fine undyed cloth, a high collar; a narrow black sash. Hands and objects: both hands hold the spotted-bamboo umbrella's handle, thin fingers; one small bronze rain-cup, the shape of a bell without a clapper, hangs on a cord from the umbrella rib. Background: a wash of pale grey with faint slanted lines of rain, the faint shape of a tall tower and a forest. Light: faint, even and pale, as from old silk. Expression: still, listening, lost in sound.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the drummer's boy at sixteen, the day he climbed the cone with the storm notes in his head. One ear is turned toward the sky, his palms callused by the drumsticks.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened, of a thin boy of sixteen on a hill path with his head tilted so that one ear points at the sky, as at a far thunder. Face: most important, the head tilted hard to the right and the left ear lifted toward the sky, the eyes unfocused. A thin, earnest, dark-skinned boy's face with high cheekbones; large, dark, distant eyes; thin straight brows; a straight nose; a firm young mouth slightly open. Hair: black, matted with rain, tied up in a knot with a strip of drum-skin. Body: thin, tall for his age, a little bent. Clothing: a plain grey robe of undyed cloth, too short in the sleeve, a rough black cape of oiled cloth; a rope belt. Hands and objects: both open hands held at his chest, palms facing the viewer, thick yellow callus pads across each palm, drumstick marks plain to see; two worn wooden drumsticks held between the left fingers. Background: a pale grey wash with the faint shape of a slope, clouds and a lightning fork far behind. Light: faint, even and pale as old silk. Expression: intent, distant, and unafraid.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the founder's war captain in 618, bareheaded in the rain in the burning orchards of Hồng Vũ Thành, refusing to leave. His red beard is wet. The red rain that fell was said to be his.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened, of a bareheaded man standing in falling rain, jaw set, as petals and sparks drift past him, refusing to leave the burning orchards. Face: most important, a thick, wet, rust-red beard, trimmed square, vivid against the faded silk, and a bareheaded brow streaming with rain. It is a broad, hard, weathered face with deep-set pale blue-grey eyes, steady; heavy red-brown brows; a big straight nose with a scar across the bridge; and a wide stubborn mouth. Hair: red-brown, wet, cropped short and plastered to the skull. Body: big and deep-chested, with square shoulders planted wide. Clothing: a black oiled-silk rain cloak, scuffed at the edges by campaigns and thrown back from the shoulders, over a scale jerkin of dark-grey lacquered leather with a high collar; no hat. Hands and objects: his right hand holds the grip of a long plain sword planted point-down in the earth in front of him, the left hand resting over it. Background: pale grey rain and drifting pink and red petals, the faint orange glow of burning trees far behind. Light: faint, even and pale, with a red-orange tint at the edges as if from distant fire. Expression: stubborn and fearless, immovable, the look of a captain who has decided that this ground is the last he will give up.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the guest elder at the Night Rain Edict in 905, arriving by night with his scripture as his price. A grey, dry man; his hand, offered in greeting, leaves the hand it touches cold.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened, of a dry grey old man at a doorway at night, offering one pale hand to shake with a thin smile. Face: most important, his skin is ash-grey and dry as paper, with no flush at all, and his extended hand is just as grey, long and bony. A narrow, gaunt, grey face; heavy-lidded, patient, dark eyes, the whites yellowish; thin grey brows; a sharp thin nose; a thin pale mouth with a patient, empty smile; a wisp of grey beard. Hair: white-grey, thin, tied up tight in a knot with a black wood pin. Body: tall, thin, upright, dry. Clothing: a long black oiled-silk rain cloak, new, over a robe of undyed grey cloth, the collar high; his cuffs very clean; a straw rain hat hanging on his back by a cord. Hands and objects: the right hand held out in greeting, long fingers; the left holds a slim scroll tied with a black cord against his chest. Background: a wash of pale grey with the faint shape of a doorway and slanting rain. Light: faint, even and pale, cold as old silk. Expression: patient, thin-smiling, cold and unreadable.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the lightning-rod man on the wall of Thủ Lôi Bảo in 1042, bareheaded in a storm, holding on the ninth day. His Thunder lets him stand under a strike. He burns with the wall.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened, of a huge bareheaded man standing on a stone wall in a storm with a tall iron rod beside him, lightning forking behind. Face: most important, a huge, square, bareheaded man with his face turned straight up into the storm, hair standing on end and a faint scorch on the cheeks. A broad, rough, brown face with a heavy jaw; small bright eyes, half shut against the rain; thick black brows; a flat wide nose; a mouth set in a stubborn line. Hair: black, wet, standing up on end in thick spikes. Body: enormous, broad as a door, planted. Clothing: a black oiled-silk rain cloak, scorched along the hem and left unmended, open at the chest over an undyed grey robe, scorch marks across the shoulders; no hat. Hands and objects: both hands wrapped round a long black iron rod, taller than him, the top lost in the faded sky. Background: a pale wash of grey with a forked white line of lightning and the faint line of a wall. Light: faint, even and pale, with a thin white flash at the edge. Expression: steadfast, loyal and slow.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the head's Dao partner at Đan Sơn Mạch, holding the rear guard. She laughs loudly, hair cropped short for the sword, the pass at her back. She has sent four people out with the wounded.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened, of a tall woman at a mountain pass with a sword resting on her shoulder, laughing loudly with her head thrown back, holding the rear guard. Face: most important, her black hair is cropped very short above the ears, almost like a man's, and she laughs with her whole open mouth. It is a tall ferryman's daughter's strong, wide, weathered face, with bright dark eyes creased with laughter, strong straight brows, a wide nose, and a big mouth showing strong white teeth. Hair: black, cut short and uneven for the sword, no ornament. Body: tall and strong-shouldered, with long arms and a swordswoman's easy, planted stance. Clothing: a black oiled-silk rain cloak thrown back from the shoulders, over a clean grey robe with a high collar and a black sash; mud splashed on the hem from the pass. Hands and objects: a plain unsheathed sword rests flat on her right shoulder, held by the hilt; her left hand sits on her hip. Background: a pale grey wash, the faint walls of a narrow pass, slanting rain. Light: faint, even and pale as old silk. Expression: a big laugh, brave and loving, with a flash of wrath in the eyes at whatever lies beyond the pass.

people.imagined: The ridge before a storm. Her hair is standing up a little in the charged air and she grins at the sky. Gold dust glints in the creases of her knuckles. She wants to choose her own master.
people.subject: The moment: on a ridge before a storm she grins up at the dark sky, her hair beginning to lift from her head with static. Face: most important, her black hair stands up in wisps and floating strands all round her head in the charged air, and her knuckles glint with gold dust. A wiry young woman's narrow, bright face, tanned; large, quick, dark eyes shining with delight; thin, dark, upswept brows; a short nose; a wide, quick mouth in a daring grin; a chipped tooth. Hair: black, in a high tail whose strands rise and float. Body: wiry, springy, a duellist's stance. Clothing: a black oiled-silk rain cloak thrown back, scorched at the hem, over a jerkin of oiled brown leather riveted at the front, a stream-washer's apron cut down; grey sleeves. Hands and objects: her right hand grips the hilt of a plain sword with a faint gold-flecked blade at her hip; the knuckles of the hand lifted in the frame glitter with fine gold dust. Background: a dark purple-grey storm sky with a thin white fork of lightning, a slope. Light: cold bright light from the upper left, a faint blue crackle at her hair. Expression: bold, restless, eager.

people.imagined: The night of spring rain. He sits with a three-stringed qin on his knees and turns his whole body toward a speaker, the way the blind do. He wants to hear the founder's chain ring. He will not be anyone's weapon.
people.subject: The moment: on a night of spring rain he sits with a qin across his knees and has turned his whole body toward someone who spoke, his face lifted, the way the blind do. Face: most important, his eyes are milky white, wide open and unfocused, with no visible iris, pointed just past the viewer. It is a thin, pale, finely made young man's face with a high forehead, delicate lifted brows, a straight narrow nose, a soft, patient mouth, and a faint smile of attention. Hair: black and long, tied in a loose tail at the nape with a grey cord, a few damp strands clinging to the brow. Body: thin and slight, narrow-shouldered, the torso turned square to the voice. Clothing: a long black oiled-silk rain cloak, damp and well cut, over a robe of undyed grey cloth with a neat collar and a plain black sash. Hands and objects: a qin of dark wood lies across his knees, only four of its seven strings remaining; his right hand rests lightly on the strings, and a small brass stall bell hangs on a cord from the qin's end. Along the qin's side lies the sword Apricot Rain in a plain black scabbard, its grip carved all over in apricot blossom for his thumb to read. Background: a dark hall at night, rain on a lattice window, the soft glow of a lantern. Light: soft warm lantern light from the upper left, rain-blue behind. Expression: attentive and calm, a humble, listening patience in the brow and mouth, as if the next word might matter more than anything else.

people.imagined: Late afternoon in the Tower's stores, counting jars. His lips move as someone passes outside. A neat, forgettable man, he has counted everything and kept two ledgers; he wishes only to die in bed in the Pivot's city.
people.subject: The moment: in a storeroom at late afternoon he counts a shelf of jars with one finger, his lips moving silently, and slides his eyes sideways to the doorway where someone passes. Face: most important, his lips are caught moving, forming silent numbers, and his eyes slide sideways, watchful and wary, within a perfectly plain, unmemorable face. It is a neat, pale, middle-aged face with thin mouse-brown brows, a small straight nose, and a small pursed mouth. Hair: thinning brown, combed flat to the skull into a neat small knot. Body: slight, neat and narrow-shouldered, buttoned up to the throat. Clothing: an immaculate undyed grey robe with a high collar, a plain black sash, and a black oiled-silk rain cloak folded over one arm; the cuffs are spotless. Hands and objects: the right forefinger touches a ceramic jar on the shelf, the middle finger showing a shiny ink callus; a small string abacus is held in the left hand. Background: a blurred shelf of identical jars, a lamp, a doorway of grey rain. Light: dim warm light from the upper left, a cool grey from the doorway. Expression: neutral and careful, a slight fearfulness in the held breath, the face of a man who has counted everything and wishes only to be left alone.

people.imagined: A midday at the new seat. He is big and easy, a bamboo staff on his shoulder, in his green Xuyên Lâm tunic under a borrowed black cloak. He has waited thirty years as a surety and does not want to be thanked.
people.subject: The moment: at midday on a ridge he leans easily on a long bamboo staff resting over his shoulder, with a relaxed, friendly look, a man who has waited thirty years and does not want to be thanked. Face: most important, a borrowed black oiled-silk rain cloak, too short in the sleeve, worn over a bright green tunic with a rolled collar, the green clearly showing at the neck and wrists. It is a big, easy, round, sun-brown face with kind brown eyes and deep laugh lines, thick brows, a broad nose, a wide mouth in a half smile, and a short grey-streaked beard. Hair: black with grey, tied in a short tail with a green cord. Body: big and broad, a thick-chested wanderer's frame, shoulders loose. Clothing: a clean green tunic of heavy cotton with a rolled collar and cloth buttons; over it the borrowed black cloak; a grey cloth belt; a straw hat hanging at his back by its cord. Hands and objects: a long bamboo staff, pale green and jointed, held over the right shoulder in the right hand; the left hand open at his side, relaxed. Background: a blurred ridge, misty trees and a pale sky. Light: soft daylight from the upper left, warm on his face. Expression: friendly and easy, with a quiet homesickness in the eyes behind the half smile.

people.imagined: Evening at the new seat, ringing the evening bell. Her palms bear bell-rope callus. A solid freckled woman who has carried her master's letters and read one.
people.subject: The moment: at evening she hauls on a thick bell-rope with both hands, her head bowed, a faint pull of her body. Face: most important, both palms carry thick yellow callus ridges across them, shown in the rope-gripping hands in the lower frame, and her freckled face is lowered. A solid, freckled, plain woman's face, rosy and round; small, steady, light brown eyes; straight sandy brows; a short nose spattered with freckles; a wide, closed mouth. Hair: sandy-brown with grey, plaited and pinned flat to her head. A band of grey runs back from each temple into the tight pinned braid, and a loose curl of ginger hair sticks out behind one ear. Body: solid, strong, thick through the waist, planted. Clothing: a black oiled-silk rain cloak, tidy, pinned back off the arms; an undyed grey robe, sleeves tied back, a black sash. A small bronze bell hangs from a cord at her belt, and the hem of her grey robe is neatly stitched with three rows of tiny stitches where it was let down. Hands and objects: both hands wrapped round a rough hemp bell-rope that rises out of the frame, callus ridges showing across the palms; a small bronze bell hangs on her belt. Slung across the back, past the left shoulder rises the hilt of a well-made long straight sword whose steel gives back a faint violet cast, its grip wrapped in thick plaited hemp like a bell-rope and worn glossy where her palm presses, a round guard of dark bronze, a scabbard of black oiled wood with a bronze band at the mouth, and a small bell tied to the pommel with its clapper stuffed with wool. Background: a blurred stone bell tower in the dusk, a warm window. Light: soft amber evening light from the upper left. Late sun glances along the rope and shows each fibre, and gilds the freckles across her nose. Expression: faithful, quiet and burdened.

people.imagined: Dawn at the outer gate, the Kinh Trập bell test. A stooped, kindly man uses a herder's crook as a pointer. He has rung eighty springs, and remembers the one year it did not answer him.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn at a gate he points with the hooked end of a herder's crook, stooping kindly toward a child out of frame, explaining something patiently. Face: most important, the long wooden herder's crook with its curved hook in his raised hand, used like a pointer. It is a stooped, kindly man's long, soft face, leathery brown and creased with smile lines, with mild dark eyes, thin white bushy brows, a broad nose, a kind mouth slightly open as if explaining, and a white beard. Hair: white and thin, tied in a small topknot under a straw rain hat. Body: stooped, thin and long-armed. Clothing: a black oiled-silk rain cloak, clean and well kept, over a plain undyed grey robe of fine cloth, a cord belt, and a small wooden whistle hanging on a cord round his neck; his sandals are tied with new cord. Hands and objects: the crook held out in the right hand, its hook worn pale and smooth by decades of handling and its shaft notched with small marks, one for each year the bell has rung; the left hand cupped behind his ear; a big bronze bell hangs from a post behind and above him. A well-made long straight sword, its grip wrapped in faded straw-coloured hemp, a plain crescent guard of grey iron, a scabbard of scuffed brown-black leather with a wooden toggle, its chape worn through and capped with a horn tip is slung diagonally across the back, its hilt showing above the right shoulder. Background: a gate of grey timber, mist and a pale dawn. Light: soft pale dawn light from the upper left, a low rosy light touching the white wisps of his beard and the bronze of the bell. Expression: gentle and patient, the warm, teacherly look of a man who has done this eighty springs and still listens for the one that did not answer.

people.imagined: A hard morning on a duelling ground. He has just won his thirty-first duel and looks at his sleeve, where two red names are stitched, wanting a third. His nose is a hawk's.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a duelling ground after a win, he looks down at his left sleeve with a hard, wanting look, then lifts his hawk face, wanting a third. Face: most important, a sharp hooked hawk's nose, and, held forward and plainly visible, the left sleeve of his robe carrying two names stitched in bright red thread, drawn as small red marks rather than writing. It is a hard, lean face with dark, narrow, glittering eyes, heavy straight black brows, a long thin jaw, and a thin, hard, level mouth. Hair: black, tied in a tight topknot with a black iron pin. Body: lean, rangy and tall, in a duellist's coiled stance. Clothing: a long black oiled-silk rain cloak thrown back from the shoulders, over a grey robe of fine undyed cloth with a high collar and tight sleeves, the left sleeve bearing the two red stitched marks; a black sash. Hands and objects: his right hand rests on the hilt of a plain sword in a black scabbard at his hip; the left arm is bent upward to show the sleeve. Background: a pale wet stone ground, a few blurred watchers, slanting rain. Light: cold grey light from the upper left, shining on wet stone and the black cloak. Expression: hard, proud and hungry, a stare with no warmth in it, like a hawk watching the next opening.

people.imagined: Late night, the lamp low, a book open on her knees, her sword sheathed beside her. She has read the righteous manual every night since 1150 and her sword has grown gentler than the Tower likes. Ink on her cuffs.
people.subject: The moment: late at night she looks up from a book open on her knee, her sword sheathed and laid aside, and gives a small, quiet bow of the head. Face: most important, black ink stains on both white-grey cuffs, bold dark smudges, and the sheathed sword laid at her side. A quiet, calm, oval face, pale and clear; gentle dark eyes shadowed from reading; fine, level brows; a straight nose; a soft, closed mouth with a trace of a smile; a tiny ink smudge on one cheek. Hair: black, plain, parted in the middle and tied low at the nape with a grey ribbon. Body: slim, upright, gentle. Clothing: an undyed grey robe of fine cloth with a high collar and sleeves cuffed in ink-stained white linen; a black oiled-silk rain cloak folded beside her; a black sash. Hands and objects: a thin old book with a worn blue cover, open in her left hand; her right hand rests on a plain sword in a black scabbard laid across her lap. Background: a dim room, a low lamp, a cupboard door ajar, rain on the window. Light: warm lamplight from the lower left, cool dark blue behind. Expression: gentle, absorbed, compassionate.

people.imagined: The ferry inn at Thu Trì, rainy evening. She wears her rain-cap even under the roof, never asking a guest's name. Her palms keep the grooves of ferry rope. She sends everything up to Nhiếp.
people.subject: The moment: under the roof of an inn, in a rain-cap, she pours tea for an unseen guest and does not ask who they are. Face: most important, a conical straw rain-cap worn even indoors, pulled low, the shadow across her brow. A square, stolid, weathered woman's face; narrow, pale grey, watching eyes; lined brow; a straight nose; a thin, patient, closed mouth; deep lines round it. A faint scar crosses her chin, and her eyelashes are short and pale, giving her gaze a flat, calm look. Hair: grey, tucked up under the cap, a grey lock at the ear. The conical rain-cap's cord is tied under the chin with a flat knot, and a single grey plait hangs from beneath it over the left shoulder. Body: stout, broad-shouldered, a landlady's solidity. Clothing: a black oiled-silk rain cloak worn open over an undyed grey robe with an apron of dark cloth tied over it; sleeves pushed above the wrist. Hands and objects: she pours from a heavy clay teapot into a bowl; the palms and fingers show deep grooves worn by ferry rope. Slung across the back, past the left shoulder rises the hilt of a well-made straight double-edged sword with faint beads of damp on the steel, its grip wrapped in tarred ferry-rope hemp, a flat oval guard of dark pewter, a scabbard of waxed grey canvas over wood with a rope loop, and a small flat lead ferry token tied at the pommel. Background: a blurred inn room with a low table and benches, a window of grey rain, a hanging lamp. Light: warm lamp light from the upper left, grey rain beyond. The lamp throws a soft amber pool on the table and the underside of her cap's brim. Expression: guarded, patient, courteous.

people.imagined: Drilling in the Thu Trì rain at dawn. He wants the sword, not the abacus. He grins like a stall-keeper when he forgets himself. His thumb is a swordsman's.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn he stands in pouring rain with a sword raised, mid-drill, when a shopkeeper's grin breaks across his face. Face: most important, a wide, bright stall-keeper's grin, all teeth, breaking through the stern drill face, and a heavy callus ridge on the thumb of his sword hand. A round, friendly, rain-wet face, brown and open; quick, bright, brown eyes; thick brows; a snub nose; a wide mouth in a broad grin. Water drips from his brow and the tip of his nose, and a little white scar from a childhood abacus bite sits on his chin. Hair: black, plastered wet, tied in a short tail. Body: sturdy, broad, light on his feet. His feet are set wide on the wet cobbles, his sword arm straight and the shoulder low. Clothing: a black oiled-silk rain cloak thrown back, soaked; an undyed grey robe with sleeves tied back; a black sash; a straw hat on his back. Hands and objects: a plain sword held up in the right hand, the thumb thick with a swordsman's callus; the other hand open in a stance. Background: grey rain, wet market stalls blurred, a lantern. Behind him a row of closed stalls with wet canvas awnings and a hanging lantern swinging, and a tiny figure that might be his father in a doorway. Light: cold grey dawn light from the upper left, a gleam on the wet blade. Expression: earnest, then a sudden big grin.

people.imagined: The foundry at Tử Kim Khoáng. She tilts her head to a bronze cup she has just cast, tuning by ear. She is the forge master's daughter and calm.
people.subject: The moment: in a foundry she holds a freshly cast small bronze cup near her ear and taps it with a rod, her head tilted toward the note. Face: most important, her head tilted hard to one side toward a small bronze rain-cup held at her ear, and a pensive half-smile. A calm, square-jawed, strong woman's face, tanned; thoughtful, half-closed, dark eyes; heavy straight brows; a straight nose; a closed, mild mouth; a smear of bronze dust on the chin. A fine dusting of bronze powder sits on her cheek, and her ears are large and fine-shaped, cupped slightly forward as if always listening. Hair: black, in a thick knot, a bronze pin. Short strands escape the knot at her nape, stuck with sweat. Body: strong, broad-shouldered, sturdy. Clothing: a black oiled-silk rain cloak, scorched at the hem; an undyed grey robe with sleeves tied back; a leather apron; a black sash. Hands and objects: the left hand holds a bright bronze cup, shaped like a small bell, beside her ear; the right holds a slim iron tapping rod. Slung across the back, past the left shoulder rises the hilt of a well-made long straight sword with a faint violet temper-line, its grip covered in black ray-skin, a guard cast in dark bronze left unpolished, a scabbard of slate-grey lacquered wood, and a small bronze rain-chain cup of her own casting for a pommel. Background: an orange-lit foundry, a row of cups on a rack, blurred. On a rack behind her, eleven finished cups of descending size hang in a row on cords, each a slightly different gold. Light: warm orange light from the right, bronze highlights. Expression: Head tilted toward the cup, eyes half closed in attention, a calm and quietly content mouth.

people.imagined: Beside the lake in the rain, still as a heron. The rain collects in her sleeves. She has learned the names of the dead in the lake.
people.subject: The moment: standing very still at a lakeshore in rain, one foot slightly forward, like a heron, with water dripping from her sleeves. Face: most important, her wide black sleeves drip steadily with rainwater, water running off the cuffs in threads, and she stands utterly still. A narrow, pale, tranquil oval face, wet; calm, grey-green eyes; fine arched brows; a long straight nose; a small calm mouth. Fine drops of rain stand on her eyelashes and the tip of her nose, and her lips are pale with cold. Hair: black, plain, in a low bun with a single white lotus petal tucked in. Body: tall, thin, straight-necked, a heron's stillness. Her neck is long and her weight rests on one leg, the other foot lifted slightly, like a wading heron. Clothing: a black oiled-silk rain cloak with wide dripping sleeves over an undyed grey robe, the collar neat; a straw hat hanging back. Hands and objects: both hands folded in her wet sleeves; one pale withered lotus stem rises from the lake at her side. Past the right shoulder rises the pale blue-corded hilt of a well-made long straight sword slung on the back, its blue-black scabbard held by a plain strap, the blade of blue-grey steel. Background: a grey lake with rain rings, withered lotus leaves, a pale mist. Light: soft cool grey light from the upper left. A pale shimmer lies on the lake behind her, and a faint rim of light edges her shoulders. Expression: A serene, still face with lowered eyes, rain on her lashes, a soft closed mouth and a humble, listening quiet.

people.imagined: The soul vault, lamps in rows. She writes a name on a new lamp, pale as wax. The vault boys swear she casts no shadow. She keeps her own list of every lamp that has gone out.
people.subject: The moment: in a dim vault she paints marks on a small new lamp with a fine brush, her face lit from below. Face: most important, her skin is pale as candle wax, and the light behind her throws no shadow on the wall. A pale, oval, wax-white face; large dark eyes, lowered; thin, fine brows; a narrow nose; a small pale mouth; fine blue veins at the temple. Fine blue veins show at her temples and in the hollow of the throat, and her lips are almost the same colour as her skin. Hair: black, in a smooth coil pinned with a thin silver pin. Body: slight, narrow, thin. Clothing: a black oiled-silk rain cloak folded beside her, a grey robe with ink-dark cuffs, high collar, black sash. Hands and objects: a small, round, clay lamp with a cloth shade held in the left hand; a fine brush in the right; behind her rows of identical small lamps on shelves, a few lit, most dark. On a low table at her elbow lies a second thin book, tied with black thread, in which, she thinks, each lamp's end is kept; it is closed. Background: a dim vault with shelves of lamps, a pale wall without shadow. Light: small warm lamp glow from below. The little flame lights only her chin and the underside of her nose; above it her eyes are dark hollows. Expression: quiet, reclusive, careful.

people.imagined: The market behind the counter. He sticks out a green-tinged tongue as a guarantee to a customer, a callous, patient grin. He sells his own poisons.
people.subject: The moment: at a market counter he sticks out his tongue at the viewer, wholly tinted green, as a guarantee, grinning. Face: most important, a long, stuck-out tongue stained a vivid pale green all over, and green stains round the lips. A lean, narrow, sallow face; small, sly, yellow-brown eyes; thin straight brows; a hooked nose; a wide mouth open in a grin. His front teeth are tinted faintly green too, and a thin line of green runs along the lower lip. Hair: black, greasy, hanging lank, tied in a rough string. Body: lean, narrow, slouching. His weight is on his elbows over the counter, the head thrust forward like a heron's, the narrow shoulders hunched up. Clothing: a black oiled-silk rain cloak in a plain, clean cut over an undyed grey robe stained green at the cuffs; a leather apron; a row of little stoppered bottles on a cord at his chest. Hands and objects: both hands flat on a market counter, the fingers stained green at the tips; before him a small row of little glass vials of different liquids. Background: a blurred market stall with hanging dried herbs and frogs, a lantern, rain. Light: warm lamplight from the upper left. The lamp throws sharp moving shadows across the counter and gives his tongue an unhealthy glow. Expression: sly, cheerful, callous.

people.imagined: The storm drill on the peak, drum in hand, shouting. A drum-skin tattooed round one forearm. He flogs the last boy or the third as the drum decides.
people.subject: The moment: on a peak in a storm he beats a big drum slung at his hip, shouting an order with his mouth wide open. Face: most important, a drum-skin pattern tattooed in black rings round his bare right forearm, plainly visible as he swings the drumstick, and a roaring mouth. A thick, red, bearded face; small, fierce, pale eyes; heavy, down-slanted brows; a boxer's nose; a wide shouting mouth full of broken teeth; a thick grey beard. Deep furrows run from nose to chin on each side and a vein stands out on the temple from shouting. Hair: grey, cropped short, a black cloth round the head. Body: stocky, thick-necked, shoulders like a bull. Clothing: a black oiled-silk rain cloak, scorched at the hem and unmended, pinned back at the shoulder; an undyed grey jerkin, sleeves cut off; a black sash. Hands and objects: a drumstick of dark wood held up in the right hand, the tattooed forearm bare; a flat barrel drum hanging at his belt, rain streaming off it. The drum's skin is stretched taut and painted with a faded ring of black, and rain streams down its rim in bright threads. Slung across the back, past the left shoulder rises the hilt of a well-made narrow straight sword, its grip bound in a taut strip of pale drum-skin, a plain squared bar guard of black iron, a scabbard of ink-black leather scuffed grey at knee height, and a short rawhide thong knotted at the pommel. Background: dark storm clouds, a lightning flash, a ridge, blurred. Light: cold white light from the upper left, a flicker of lightning. Each lightning flash picks out the ring-pattern of the tattoo like carved lines. Expression: Mouth wide open mid-shout, teeth bared, brows slammed down and the veins standing in his neck, his eyes blazing and wild.

people.imagined: Under the eaves of the old tower in the rain, singing to the founder's chain, a green ribbon round her wrist. She chose to stay when her year went east.
people.subject: The moment: under the eaves of an old tower in rain she is singing, mouth open, her hand lifted as if to the hanging chain. Face: most important, a bright green ribbon knotted round her raised wrist, vivid against the black and grey. A round, open, kindly face, fair, flushed; bright dark eyes closed in song; soft brows; a small nose; a wide open mouth, singing. A small gap between her front teeth shows when she sings, and her cheeks are rosy with the damp air. Hair: dark brown, in a long loose braid, the end tied with green thread. Beads of rain sit like pearls along the braid and a loose curl clings to her temple. Body: slim, upright, soft-shouldered. Her chest is lifted and her chin up as she sings, throat bare to the eaves. Clothing: a black oiled-silk rain cloak open over an undyed grey robe, high collar, black sash. Hands and objects: the right hand lifted high, a green ribbon knotted round the wrist; at the edge, a long bronze chain of small cups hangs from the eaves, water running down it. A well-made narrow straight sword in a blue-black scabbard is slung diagonally across the back; its pewter guard and the grip wrapped in pale blue cord show above the right shoulder. Background: a grey tower eave, slanting rain, a blurred forest. Light: soft grey light from the upper left. A pale light slides along the wet bronze cups and lights the water as it runs down. Expression: content, open and joyful.

people.imagined: Evening in the dining hall of the new seat, wine going round, the Thunder Hall muttering about him. He sits stiffly with violet dust in his cuffs and a faint, stubborn lift of the chin.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a long table in lamplight, he looks straight at the viewer with his chin lifted, deliberately ignoring murmurs behind him. Face: most important, his cuffs and the heels of his hands are ground with fine amethyst-violet dust that sparkles, plainly seen against the grey cloth. A lean, handsome, serious young man's face; dark brows; level dark eyes; a straight nose; a firm, closed mouth; short stubble. A faint line of fatigue sits under each eye, and a tiny scar shows in the left eyebrow from the mine. Hair: black, tied in a high tail with a black cord. A small amethyst bead is tied into the tail with the cord, and a few strands have come loose at the neck. Body: tall, rangy, upright. Clothing: a black oiled-silk rain cloak with scorched hems, an undyed grey robe of fine cloth with a high collar, a black sash; a small violet crystal pendant. Hands and objects: both hands on the table, the violet dust visible in cuffs and knuckle creases; a bowl of rice before him. Slung across the back, past the left shoulder rises the hilt of a well-made long straight sword with a thin violet shimmer along the edge, its grip wrapped in slate-grey silk cord with fine amethyst grit worked into the weave, a rounded-square guard of dark steel, and a scabbard of black oiled wood. Background: a blurred dim hall, lamps, hunched figures turned away. Behind him two Thunder Hall men sit with their backs turned, one lifting a wine cup. Light: warm lamplight from the upper left, a faint violet gleam at his cuffs. Expression: stubborn, proud, hurt and steady.

people.imagined: At the mine tally shed, a heated argument over a count. A ledger sticks from his belt. He leans in with red knuckles, ready to break a third arm.
people.subject: The moment: in a shed doorway he leans forward in a confrontation, jaw out, red knuckles on a wooden counter. Face: most important, a white scar slashes straight through his left eyebrow, splitting the brow in two, and his knuckles are red and swollen. A square, hard, flushed face; dark, glaring eyes, one brow cut; a broken nose; a thick, tight mouth; short black beard. Hair: black, cropped, a bit of purple stone dust in it. A strand of grey is already showing at his temple, and a bit of violet stone dust sparkles in the stubble of his jaw. Body: stocky, heavy-shouldered, pushed forward. Clothing: a black oiled-silk rain cloak, worn open, over an undyed grey robe with sleeves tied back; a thick book with a cloth cover pushed into his belt; a black sash. A heavy leather belt with an iron buckle holds the robe, and a small hammer for testing stone hangs from it. Hands and objects: both fists planted on the counter, knuckles red and scraped; a chunk of violet thunder-glass the size of a fist beside them. Slung across the back, past the left shoulder rises the hilt of a well-made slim jian, its grip wrapped in scuffed brown leather, a round guard of dull pewter dented on one side, and a scabbard of hard black horn-faced wood with its throat chipped. Background: a blurred timber mine shed, lamps, tools. Light: harsh light from the upper left. A hard slice of light from the door puts a bright edge along the knuckles and the violet glass. Expression: belligerent, hard-set, touchy.

people.imagined: The coast house at Lãng Hoa, dusk. She sits sideways at a table, never with her back to the window, a key on a cord at her chest. Salt dries in her hair. She has made a bargain north she is not telling anyone.
people.subject: The moment: seated sideways at a table by a sea window at dusk, she keeps her eyes on the window and lets only half a smile reach the viewer. Face: most important, a heavy iron key on a leather cord hanging over her chest, held between two fingers, and a grey-white crust of dried salt in her black hair. A clever, handsome, brown face, sharp at the cheekbones; dark, shrewd, half-lidded eyes; arched brows; a slim nose; a closed, amused mouth. Hair: black, loosely bound in a knot, streaked with white salt. A thread of white runs from the left temple, where the salt has dried, and a single pearl hairpin glints in the knot. Body: slim, upright, one shoulder turned. Her shoulders are turned so that her back is to the wall and her face to the window, in a guarded half-seated pose. Clothing: a black oiled-silk rain cloak, spotted with salt, over an undyed grey robe of fine cloth, the collar high, a black sash. Hands and objects: the right hand lifts a big iron house key on a leather cord; the left rests by a small clay cup. Slung across the back, the hilt of a well-made slim jian with a round guard rises past the left shoulder, in a blue-black scabbard, the grip wrapped in pale blue cord, a pewter guard. Background: a window with a dusky grey sea and masts, a lamp. A map of the coast pinned on the wall, with small red marks, and a narrow shelf of shells. Light: cool blue dusk from the window, warm lamp from the lower left. Expression: wary, amused, calculating.

people.imagined: Sorting pebbles at the mine mouth, he holds one flower-shaped stone to the light. A cough follows from a boy beside him; he is counting stones, not boys.
people.subject: The moment: at a mine mouth he holds a small pebble up between finger and thumb to the light, squinting, ignoring a cough beside him. Face: most important, a small flower-shaped pebble, pale pink and white like a cherry blossom, held at eye level, and fine pebble dust on his sleeves. A dry, narrow, lined face; small, pale, weighing eyes; sparse brows; a long nose; thin lips in a calculating line; a trimmed grey goatee. Hair: iron grey, in a topknot. A tiny paper cap of mine dust sits on the knot, and the grey at the temples is sharply combed. Body: spare, upright, fussy. He stands with feet together, upright and fastidious, elbows close to the ribs, his whole stance a measure of cold exactness. Clothing: a black oiled-silk rain cloak, folded neatly over one arm, an undyed grey robe with sleeves dusted pale; a black sash; a leather pouch of pebbles. Hands and objects: the right hand lifts the flower-stone; the left holds a flat wooden tray with rows of small round stones. Slung across the back, past the left shoulder rises the hilt of a well-made straight double-edged sword, its grip wrapped in grey-brown hemp, a guard cut in a plain five-lobed flower outline from dark iron, a scabbard of slate-grey hide, and a small flower-shaped pebble held in a net of cord at the pommel. Background: a wet mine mouth, dark rock, a hint of a small boy's hair at the edge. Behind, in the mine mouth's shadow, a small thin boy with a wet shirt sits coughing into a hand, only half visible. Light: cold grey light from the upper left. Expression: precise, cool, uncaring.

people.imagined: A night vigil by the water clock, head cocked to the drip. Dark under-eyes. He reports every lamp he sees lit.
people.subject: The moment: at night beside a brass water clock he cocks his head to listen to a drip, eyes wide in the dim light. Face: most important, one deep bruise-purple shadow under the eye, hollow with sleeplessness, and the head cocked sharply to the left. A thin, pale young face; wide light eyes with a dark smudge beneath; thin brows; a narrow nose; a small, tight mouth; stubble. Hair: dark brown, tied in a short tail. A few loose strands fall in his eyes and he has not pushed them back for hours. Body: thin, stooped, alert. He sits cross-legged on a straw mat, spine curved forward, with one ear a hand's width nearer the clock. Clothing: a black oiled-silk rain cloak around the shoulders, an undyed grey robe, black sash; a woollen scarf. The grey robe's cuffs are folded back, tiny ink flecks pepper the right sleeve, and a thin woollen scarf winds twice round his neck against the night chill. Hands and objects: a small notebook and brush held in the left hand; the right finger lifted as if counting drips. Background: a dim hall, a tall brass-and-clay water clock dripping, a single lamp. Light: a low yellow lamp from the right. A single drop catches the lamp light and shines like a bead as it falls. Expression: intent, tired, watchful.

people.imagined: On the ridge road, about to turn a corner, she blows a reed whistle first. She was born below the old tower and carried east as a child.
people.subject: The moment: running along a ridge road she holds a small reed whistle between her lips, cheeks puffed, about to turn a corner. Face: most important, a thin reed whistle on a thong between her lips, the thong swinging, and flushed running cheeks. A quick, narrow, brown face, wind-roughened; bright dark eyes looking ahead; sharp brows; a pointed nose; chapped lips round the whistle. Her cheeks are wind-reddened and a line of sweat shines at her hairline, and a small nick shows in her left ear. Hair: black, in a long braid flying behind. Body: lean, light, a runner's frame. She runs on the balls of the feet with elbows tucked, the whole body leaning ahead of her legs. Clothing: a short black oiled-silk rain cape, an undyed grey tunic hitched up for running, a black sash; a leather message satchel across the chest. Her boots are bound with strips of hide, spattered with ridge mud, and her tunic's hem is knotted up on one side to free her knee. Hands and objects: the left hand holds the satchel strap; the right holds the whistle's thong. A well-made narrow light sword, its grip wrapped in thin black silk cord, a slim bar guard of black iron with upturned ends, and a scabbard of lacquered split bamboo, grey-black, held with two cross-straps so it never swings while she runs is slung diagonally across the back, its hilt showing above the right shoulder. Background: a misty ridge road, wet stones, dark pines, blurred. Light: soft grey light from the upper left. A sliver of pale sun makes the dew on the road shine. Expression: brisk, alert, urgent.

people.imagined: Night walk along the Iron Rain chain, listening to a guard lie to him. He does not blink. A fern-shaped lightning scar runs down his wrist.
people.subject: The moment: at night beside a chain of iron rods he fixes an unblinking stare on a speaker out of frame, his wrist lifted, listening to a guard lie to him. Face: most important, a pale branching lightning scar like a fern frond runs down the inside of his right wrist and onto the hand, held up near his chest, and he does not blink. It is a hard, lean, sun-browned face with dark eyes and a flat gaze, heavy brows, a long straight nose, a thin level mouth and stubble; a fine web of thin burn-lines trails from the eye corners, and the lips are dry and cracked. Hair: black, short and bristly. Body: lean, tall, loose and still, standing square to the viewer with the arms relaxed and the weight perfectly balanced, ready for either a bolt or a blow. Clothing: a black oiled-silk rain cloak, scorched along the hem into a fringe like a crow's feathers from old strikes, over an undyed grey robe of good cloth with the sleeves tied back and a black sash; a brass-studded leather bracer guards the left wrist. Hands and objects: the right wrist and hand lifted into view, the scar pale against the brown skin; the left rests on the hilt of a plain sword. Background: a night ridge, a row of tall iron rods against a dark sky with distant flashes. Light: cold blue-white light from the upper left, with a flicker of lightning. Expression: cold, unblinking and testing, the flat patience of someone waiting for a lie to finish.

people.imagined: Guarding the old tower's stair, leaning on a boat-pole in a ferryman's wide-footed stance.
people.subject: The moment: on a tower stair she leans on a long boat-pole as if it were a staff, feet planted wide apart. Face: most important, a long wooden boat-pole with an iron shoe, held upright, and a wide-footed ferryman's stance. A strong, wide, brown face with a big jaw; bright, level, dark eyes; strong, straight brows; a snub nose; a wide mouth with a calm, ready half-smile. Tiny freckles speckle her nose, and a small pale scar curves along one eyebrow. Hair: short black, cropped at the nape, a green cloth round the brow. A scrap of green cloth ties her hair, and a thin tail of it drifts over her collar. Body: broad-shouldered, strong, low and steady. Clothing: a black oiled-silk rain cloak thrown back, an undyed grey robe, trousers tucked into wrapped legs, a black sash; a plain sword in a scabbard at her hip. Hands and objects: both hands on the boat-pole, one above the other; its pole's end rests on stone steps. Background: a grey old stone stair, mist, a bronze rain-chain hanging. Light: soft grey light from the upper left. A glimmer of damp lies on the stone steps and gives the iron shoe of the pole a dull shine. Expression: steady, calm, a ferryman's patience.

people.imagined: After a storm drill, dressing a burn. Her apron carries every salve in the Tower; she smells of camphor.
people.subject: The moment: after a drill she bends toward someone out of frame, dabbing salve on a burn with two fingers, her face kindly and absorbed. Face: most important, a long apron stitched all over with small pockets, each holding a little pot or jar, filling the lower frame. A round, motherly, kind face; warm brown eyes with fine crow's feet; soft, level brows; a small round nose; a gentle, closed mouth. A faint smell of camphor seems to rise from her, and a small crease sits between her brows as she studies the wound. Hair: black with grey, in a bun under a white cloth. Body: round, solid, comfortable. She bends at the waist, her weight on one foot, both hands working at once, the back wide and calm. Clothing: a black oiled-silk rain cloak hung on a hook behind, an undyed grey robe with sleeves tied back, over it a canvas apron with dozens of small pockets; a black sash. Hands and objects: the right fingers dipped in green salve; the left holds a small open pot of the salve, with a roll of bandage in the pocket. Background: a blurred infirmary shelf with jars, a bed, a window of rain. Light: soft, warm light from the upper left. A thin line of light from the window shows steam rising from a basin on the table. Expression: kind, calm and capable.

people.imagined: In the dining hall, saying loudly that her master should be head, one finger on the silver pin in her hair, the gesture she makes when she wants to be believed.
people.subject: The moment: in a hall she touches a silver hairpin with two fingers while speaking earnestly, wide-eyed, eager to be believed. Face: most important, a long, bright silver hairpin with a flat leaf-shaped end, touched by her fingers, set in her black hair. A pretty, soft, earnest, round face, fair; wide, sincere, dark eyes; delicate high brows; a small nose; a small, soft mouth, slightly open. A faint blush colours her cheeks and a tiny beauty spot sits at the outer corner of her left eye. Hair: black, in a high knot pinned with the silver pin. Body: slim, upright, eager. She leans slightly forward, hands near her chest, in the open posture of someone sure that she is right. Clothing: a black oiled-silk rain cloak, tidy, over an undyed grey robe of fine cloth with a high collar; a black sash. Hands and objects: the right hand raised to touch the silver pin; the left holds a bowl of rice. Slung across the back, past the right shoulder rises the hilt of a well-made straight double-edged sword with a faint dew-sheen on the steel, its grip wrapped in pale grey silk, a slender double-crescent guard, a scabbard of black lacquer with a thin line of silver wire round the mouth, and a tiny silver bead on the tassel cord. Background: a blurred dining hall, tables, lamps. Along the table, three disciples with bowls look down, one of them a young man with violet dust at his cuffs. Light: warm lamplight from the upper left. Expression: sincere, eager, a trace of calculation.

people.imagined: On the guardhouse wall in a storm, bareheaded, his grandfather's stance to the inch.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a guardhouse wall in a storm, bareheaded, rain streaming, feet planted and arms folded in a fixed stance held exactly as his grandfather held it. Face: most important, a bare, rain-soaked, uncovered head, no hat, and the stance held to the inch. It is a broad, heavy, stern face, brown and wet, with narrow dark eyes squinting into the rain, thick brows, a broad flat nose, a thin hard mouth and a short black beard; rain runs in lines off the heavy brows and the end of his nose, and his lips are blue with cold. Hair: black, plastered flat to the skull. Body: huge, broad and solid as a gatepost. Clothing: a black oiled-silk rain cloak of good cloth, open over an undyed grey robe and a black sash; the hem is scorched in a saw-tooth line of black and brown by old lightning strikes and left unmended on purpose; no hat. Hands and objects: arms crossed over his chest, bare forearms thick with rain, knuckles white where each hand grips the opposite elbow; a tall iron rod rises behind his shoulder, and his feet are planted a shoulder-width apart on the wet stone. Slung across the back, past the right shoulder rises the hilt of a well-made long straight sword, its grip covered in dark-grey sharkskin, a heavy squared plate guard of black iron with a blue-grey scorch tint, and a scabbard of old black leather scorch-marked at its lower end by a lightning strike and never mended, with a faint violet gleam in the steel. Background: dark storm clouds, a stone wall, a forked flash of lightning. Light: cold white light from the upper left, with flashes. Expression: stoic, steadfast and unmoved, a stone face that the storm cannot reach.

people.imagined: Arriving with letters, a worn-through satchel at her hip. She is already telling you about the meal she ate at Hồng Đậu Trang and lived.
people.subject: The moment: stopping in mid-stride with a letter in hand and a broad story-teller's grin, already boasting. Face: most important, a leather satchel worn through at one corner so a letter peeks out, hung at her hip, and a wide boasting grin. A lively, round, freckled face, wind-tanned; bright, sparkling brown eyes; quick, raised brows; a snub nose; a big grin. Hair: dark brown, in two short plaits under a straw rain hat pushed back. A damp curl sticks to each cheek and a feather from a hen is caught in one plait. Body: small, quick, light. She walks with a springy bounce, the satchel swinging, the whole body pitched forward to talk. Clothing: a short black oiled-silk rain cape, an undyed grey tunic, a black sash; mud on her boots. Her boots are caked with red road mud to the ankle, and her tunic's hem is stained in a fresh, careless splash. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a folded letter sealed with a plain blob of wax; the left hand grips the satchel strap. Past the left shoulder rises the pale blue-corded hilt of a well-made long straight sword slung on the back, its blue-black scabbard held by a plain strap, the blade of blue-grey steel. Background: a muddy road, a grey sky, a manor gate in the distance. Light: soft grey daylight from the upper left. A burst of watery sun makes the wet road shine behind her. Expression: gleeful, talkative, proud.

people.imagined: Drills in the yard; he glares across at Khúc Thanh Điện, who got the lightning he did not. Gold flecks glint in his teeth.
people.subject: The moment: in a drill yard he glares sideways with one eyebrow raised high, a tight smile showing his teeth. Face: most important, tiny flecks of gold glitter in his teeth when he bares them, and one eyebrow stays permanently raised. A square, sunburnt, handsome face; dark, resentful eyes; one eyebrow arched high; a broad nose; a tight mouth baring teeth. A thin line of sweat stands on the upper lip, and a small chip is missing from one front tooth. Hair: black, cropped, a gold-dusted fringe. Body: broad, strong-shouldered, tense. His weight is rolled onto his heels and his jaw thrusts forward, as if he were leaning into an argument. Clothing: a black oiled-silk rain cloak, an undyed grey robe with sleeves rolled, a black sash; a leather jerkin with gold dust at the seams. Hands and objects: both hands on the grip of a plain sword resting point down; gold dust in the knuckle lines. Background: a rainy drill yard, a few figures blurred, a flash in the sky. In the far corner of the yard, small and blurred, a wiry young woman with wild hair practises a lunge, a pale flash at the tip of her sword. Light: grey light from the upper left. A glint of gold dust sparkles in the creases of his knuckles and on the sword grip. Expression: resentful, proud, restless.

people.imagined: On the peak before the drill, face lifted, squinting at the sky as if it owed him money, one wet finger raised to read the wind.
people.subject: The moment: on a peak he squints at the sky with his face tilted up, one licked finger raised to the wind, doubtful. Face: most important, one index finger raised and glistening wet, held up beside his face, and a hard squint at the sky. A narrow, leathery, wrinkled face; narrow, suspicious, pale eyes squeezed small; sparse brows; a hooked nose; a pursed, sceptical mouth; a grey-flecked beard. Hair: dark, thin, bound in a cloth. A few wet grey strands blow across his brow, and a brass pin holds the knot. Body: wiry, bony, slightly bent back. His weight rests on the back foot, the neck craned and the free arm held out away from the body to read the air. Clothing: a black oiled-silk rain cloak flapping in the wind, an undyed grey robe, a black sash; a short iron rod strapped across his back. Hands and objects: the right forefinger raised wet; the left hand holds the cloak shut at the throat. Background: a bruised grey-green sky with heavy clouds, a distant ridge. Light: sullen grey-green light from above. A green-white glare underlights the hanging cloud, and a thin crack of brightness cuts the horizon. Expression: sceptical, wary, weather-wise.

people.imagined: The front of the line at the Bell Test at dawn. She stands soot-cheeked, a blackened cheap sword in her hand, jaw set, not called again. Her singed hair stands up at the ends.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn at the front of a line she stands rigid with a blackened sword held down at her side, staring at the bronze bell on its frame and willing it to answer, not called again. Face: most important, soot is smeared across both cheeks and her cropped black hair is singed brown and frizzed at every end. It is a sturdy, round, determined girl's face with dark, hot, fierce eyes holding a ring of firelight, thick straight brows, a short nose, and a hard, tight, stubborn mouth. Hair: black, cropped at the jaw, the ends curled and burnt and standing up. Body: short, sturdy and solid, squared up like a small wall. Clothing: a plain undyed grey outer-gate robe of good cloth, clean though dust-grey at the hem, a short black oiled-silk rain cloak and a black sash; charcoal smudges on the cuffs from her mother's kiln. Hands and objects: a plain sword blackened with charcoal, the blade matt black, gripped in the right fist. Background: a pale misty dawn, a big bronze bell on a wooden frame, other children standing in line, blurred. Light: cool grey dawn light from the upper left, with a faint orange glow caught in her eyes. Expression: fierce and stubborn, hurt and unyielding, the chin up and the lip pressed against tears.

people.imagined: The window sill at night. He has put a cup out to catch rain and is disappointed by dry thunder. A soft-faced boy writing poems about rain.
people.subject: The moment: at a window he holds a small empty cup out into the dark, looking at it and the dry sky with a sad, soft face. Face: most important, a plain pottery cup held out in his open palm, empty, and a soft, downcast, wistful face. A soft, round, pale boy's face, plump-cheeked; large, gentle, dark brown eyes with long lashes; low brows tilted up in the middle; a button nose; a full mouth turned down. Hair: black, loose, a little untidy, to the nape. The loose hair is slightly damp from leaning out, and a thin strand has caught on his lower lip. Body: soft, rounded, slouched. His elbows rest on the sill and his shoulders are rounded forward, a long homesick lean. Clothing: a plain undyed grey robe of fine cloth with a neat collar, a short black oiled-silk rain cloak slung over one shoulder, a black sash. Hands and objects: the right palm holds the empty cup out; the left holds a slender brush and a folded sheet. Slung across the back, the hilt of a plain narrow straight sword rises past the right shoulder, in a blue-black scabbard, the grip wrapped in pale blue cord, a pewter guard. Background: a dark window frame, a night sky with a far dry flash, no rain. On the sill behind the cup are two folded papers weighted with a pebble, and a small brush in a jar. Light: soft blue night light from the window, a small lamp glow on his cheek. Expression: homesick, sad, gentle.

people.imagined: Standing beside the soul vault window with a bamboo comb in her hand, solemn, wanting to see her brother's lamp. She claims the comb is from home; it is from Xuyên Lâm.
people.subject: The moment: standing solemnly in a lamp-lit corridor, she holds a green bamboo comb at her chest and looks at the viewer without moving. Face: most important, a pale green bamboo comb with long thin teeth held at her breast, and a long, solemn, still face. A tall girl's long, grave, pale face; steady, dark, sorrowful eyes; straight brows; a long straight nose; a calm, closed mouth. Hair: black, loose to the shoulders, half combed. A plain white ribbon is tied at the end of the unbound hair, and a short strand curls at the cheek. Body: tall, thin, upright. Her feet are together and her hands are clasped, the posture of someone waiting at a graveside. Clothing: a plain undyed grey outer-gate robe, neat and clean, with a black oiled-silk rain cloak folded on one arm, a black sash; a bundle of dried herbs at the belt. Hands and objects: both hands hold the bamboo comb at her breast; a small clay lamp glows on a shelf behind her left shoulder. Slung across the back, past the left shoulder rises the hilt of a plain slim jian, its grip bound in thin strips of split bamboo, a plain round guard of grey steel, a scabbard of dark lacquered wood, and a small bamboo peg at the mouth cut with teeth like those of her comb. Background: a dim corridor of small lamps on shelves, one lamp bright. Light: warm small lamp glow from the right, deep dark around. A tiny warm flare flickers across her cheek from the lamp, and the dark corridor behind swallows the rest. Expression: A solemn, motionless face, eyes fixed on the viewer and a little wet, lips pressed together, the comb held close.

people.imagined: In the rain beside the barrel, swaggering, a clumsy stitch over his eyebrow, daring someone to speak. Two sizes bigger than he is.
people.subject: The moment: standing in the rain with his chest thrust out and thumbs in his belt, chin high, sneering. Face: most important, a badly stitched wound cuts across his left eyebrow, black thread knots standing up and puckered pink skin around. A broad, flat, red-brown face; narrow, hard, sulky eyes; one stitched eyebrow, one thick; a broken nose; a thick-lipped sneering mouth. His lip curls on one side and a scab sits on the knuckle of the thumb that tucks in his belt. Hair: black, cropped short and rough. Body: short, thick, shoulders pushed back, belly out. His belly pushes out under the belt, his chin up and feet planted wide, the stance of a boy pretending to be big. Clothing: a plain undyed grey outer-gate robe, well made and clean, a short black oiled-silk rain cloak, a black sash. Hands and objects: thumbs hooked in the sash; at his side a wooden rain barrel overflowing. Slung across the back, past the left shoulder rises the hilt of a plain short slim sword worn a little too high, its grip wrapped lumpily in crooked strips of rag, a small round iron guard dented by his own knuckles, and a mismatched scabbard of two woods stuck together with a chewed end. Background: a wet courtyard, grey rain, a drum on a post. In the courtyard behind him a smaller boy, soaked to the skin, wipes water from his face, and the drum on its post drips. Light: cold grey light from the upper left. Expression: swaggering, cruel and eager.

people.imagined: Singing the oldest planting song at the rice plot over the graves, hat pushed back, her voice carrying.
people.subject: The moment: singing at a rice plot with her head thrown back, mouth wide, hat pushed to the back of her head. Face: most important, a rice-straw hat pushed back off the face and hanging by its cord, and a wide-open singing mouth. A round, brown, merry face, cheeks flushed; closed, laughing eyes; high, bright brows; a snub nose; a wide mouth, open in song, white teeth. Hair: black, in two thick braids over the shoulders, tied with yellow thread. Body: sturdy, strong, open-chested. Her feet are planted in the paddy water to the ankle and her back is arched, chest wide open to sing. Clothing: a plain undyed grey outer-gate robe, tucked up at the knees for the mud, a short black rain cape, a black sash; sleeves rolled. Her trousers are knotted up above the knee and splashed with brown paddy mud, and a woven grass belt holds the robe in. Hands and objects: a bundle of green rice seedlings held in the left hand; the right arm swung out in song. A plain short slim sword with a faint green bloom on the steel, its grip wrapped in plaited rice-straw cord, a small round guard of dark iron, a scabbard of woven straw over wood, and a sprig of dried rice ears tucked in at the mouth is slung diagonally across the back, its hilt showing above the left shoulder. Background: a flooded rice plot, green shoots, and small low stone grave markers beyond, a pale sky. Light: soft bright light from the upper left. The sun makes the green seedlings glow like emeralds and lights the water bright as tin. Expression: joyful, loud and warm.

people.imagined: At the forge, hauling a chain-cup out of the quench, charcoal in his eyelashes. He lied to the Bell Test about his Metal.
people.subject: The moment: at a forge he lifts a bronze cup on a hook out of a steaming trough, eyes narrowed, wary of the viewer. Face: most important, thick charcoal black clogs his eyelashes and lines the rims of his eyes, and a shiny raised quench-burn lies across the back of his hand. A narrow, dark, sooty face; sly, bright, dark eyes ringed black; stubborn brows; a thin nose; a closed, mulish mouth. Hair: black, matted with soot, tied in a rag. A few grey ash flakes lie on his hair, and the rag at his brow is dark with sweat. Body: stocky, strong, forearms bare. He leans away from the heat with one shoulder raised against the steam, weight on the left leg. Clothing: a plain undyed grey outer-gate robe, black with soot at the cuffs, a leather apron, a black sash. Hands and objects: an iron hook in the right hand with a dripping bronze cup; the back of the left hand shows a shiny pink burn. Slung across the back, past the left shoulder rises the hilt of a plain long straight sword, its grip wrapped in scorched leather gone black with charcoal, a thick plain disc guard of unpolished forge iron still rough with scale, a scabbard of scorched pine pinched flat by tongs, and a quench-hook ring tied to the pommel. Background: an orange forge mouth, steam from a trough, sparks. A trough of dark water and a row of finished cups on a rack, still glowing faintly red at the rims. Light: orange light from the right. Expression: guarded, stubborn, a little sly.

people.imagined: Holding her tray of dried apricots, counting out one short, smiling sweetly. Apricot stains on her sleeves.
people.subject: The moment: holding a wide flat tray of dried apricots at her waist, she gives a sweet smile while one hand counts out fruits on the tray. Face: most important, a flat wooden tray crowded with orange dried apricots held in both hands, filling the lower frame, and her sleeves stained orange-yellow. A pretty, round, bright face; quick, shrewd, brown eyes; arched brows; a small nose; a sweet, small, wide smile. A faint dimple shows in her left cheek, and her lashes are long and curl at the ends. Hair: black, in a high bun with an apricot flower stuck in. Body: slim, quick, neat. She holds herself very straight, the tray at a precise level, one hip cocked. Clothing: a plain undyed grey outer-gate robe, cuffs and sleeves stained orange with fruit, a short black rain cape, a black sash. Hands and objects: a wooden tray of dried apricots in both hands, the right forefinger tapping a small pile of five. A plain short slim sword, its grip wrapped in cord the colour of dried apricot, a plain iron ring guard, a scabbard of plain grey lacquer with an apricot stain at the mouth, and a polished apricot-stone bead on a thread at the pommel is slung diagonally across the back, its hilt showing above the right shoulder. Background: a blurred market stall, hanging dried fruit, soft rain. On a board behind her hang strings of dried apricot slices and coloured paper charms, swaying slightly. Light: warm light from the upper left. A glow of warm gold lights the fruit so that each piece glistens like amber. Expression: sweetly innocent, quick, avid.

people.imagined: Night beside a rain-chain, counting each drop aloud with his lips. He can count all night and not lose his place.
people.subject: The moment: standing beside a hanging bronze rain-chain at night, his lips moving silently to the rhythm of the drops, counting; he can count all night and not lose his place. Face: most important, lips parted and moving in time with the falling drops, eyes unfocused. It is a long, calm, pale, patient face with half-closed, dark, serene eyes, level brows, a straight nose, and a small mouth moving in count; the lashes are long and still, and the lips carry the faint shape of a hum. Hair: black, tied in a plain knot at the nape. Body: lean, still and straight-backed, heels together and arms loose, a perfect plumb-line of attention. Clothing: a plain undyed grey outer-gate robe, clean and neat, a black oiled-silk rain cloak and a black sash, with a herder's cord at the belt. Hands and objects: the right hand lifted, one finger counting; beside him a bronze chain of small cups hangs with water falling from one to the next, a rope of thin drops with each drop a bright point, one caught mid-air. Slung across the back, past the left shoulder rises the hilt of a plain long straight sword, its grip wrapped in grey hemp cord laid in even counted turns, a plain oval guard of dull steel, a scabbard of black oiled wood, and a hollowed drip-stone bead dangling from the pommel on a thread. Background: dark night, a faint lantern, wet stone. Light: blue night light and a small lantern glow from the left, glinting on the drops. Expression: patient and humble, entranced, the soft absorbed face of a boy listening to something no one else can hear.

people.imagined: A sunny day, carrying someone's gold pan home, trusting and friendly, no singed hair on him. His sister has the lightning, he has none.
people.subject: The moment: smiling openly while carrying a big shallow wooden pan with both hands, glad to help. Face: most important, a fine dusting of gold flecks glitters on every fingernail of his hands holding the pan. A round, trusting, freckled face, cheeks pink; wide, bright, brown eyes; arched brows; a snub nose; a wide, easy smile. A little dimple shows in his left cheek and his front teeth are slightly too big for his mouth, giving his smile a boyish gap. Hair: black, neat, without a singed hair on it, tied with a green thread. A cowlick sticks up at the crown despite the green thread, and the fringe is cut short and uneven by a sister's shears. Body: small, sturdy, light. He is a head shorter than the pan is wide, and he walks with a bounce, elbows out, the shoulders square with the effort of being careful. Clothing: a plain undyed grey outer-gate robe, fresh and clean, a short black rain cape, a black sash. Hands and objects: a shallow wooden panning dish held in both hands, glittering with a few yellow flecks; his nails gold-dusted. A plain short slim sword, its grip wrapped in black cord with gold dust glinting in the weave, a plain steel guard with a chisel-flat edge, and a scabbard of dark horn-brown wood is slung diagonally across the back, its hilt showing above the left shoulder. Background: a sunny stream bank, a drill yard, soft pale light. Light: bright light from the upper left. The bright sun makes the wet gold flecks on the dish wink like tiny coins. Expression: open, friendly, trusting.

people.imagined: Sitting on her packed bag in a fisher's hat indoors, a letter half written. She has packed and unpacked it every feast day.
people.subject: The moment: indoors she sits with a half-packed bag on her lap, a wide fisher's hat still on her head, staring into the distance. Face: most important, a big conical straw fisher's hat worn indoors, its brim shading her face, and a packed cloth bag on her knees. A narrow, restless, tan face; dark, longing eyes looking away; thin, arched brows; a small straight nose; a thin mouth pressed in doubt. A little pink shows in the tip of her nose from the draught, and a crease marks her brow. Hair: black, in a loose tail on one shoulder. The hat's chin-cord leaves a faint red line along her jaw. Body: slim, slouched forward. Clothing: a plain undyed grey outer-gate robe, a short black oiled-silk rain cape, a black sash; sleeves a little short. Hands and objects: both hands on a bundled cloth bag, knotted at the top, a half-folded letter tucked under the knot. Past the left shoulder rises the pale blue-corded hilt of a plain straight double-edged sword slung on the back, its blue-black scabbard held by a plain strap, the blade of blue-grey steel. Background: a small plain room, a bed, a window with pale light. Light: soft grey light from the upper left. A thin square of window light lies on the floor at her feet, and one corner of the unfolded letter glows white in it. Expression: longing, undecided, honest.

people.imagined: Showing the star-shaped birthmark under his ear to a visitor, proclaiming the day's lucky colour, sure the thunder means something.
people.subject: The moment: turning his head to show a birthmark under his ear to a visitor, with a proud smirk, sure the thunder means something. Face: most important, a clear dark-red star-shaped birthmark with five points under his left ear, shown by his turned head. It is a sharp, handsome, proud face with bright arrogant brown eyes, high arched brows thin and sharply drawn, a straight nose lifted slightly, a mouth in a cocky smile, and a faint trace of face-powder dusting the nose. Hair: black, in a high topknot with a bright yellow ribbon tied round it. Body: lean and strutting, shoulders back and chest pushed out like a peacock. Clothing: a plain undyed grey outer-gate robe of fine cloth with the collar open, a short black rain cape, a black sash, and a yellow cord at the wrist. Hands and objects: one hand tilts his jaw to show the mark; the other rests on a plain sword hilt. Background: a stone stair under a grey sky, and on the stair a thin young woman in a grey sleeve who stands aside with a stiff, set face, out of focus. Light: bright grey light from the upper left, clean on the skin and the red mark. Expression: proud and utterly sure of himself, the smirk of a boy who has decided what the day's lucky colour is and expects agreement.

people.imagined: Standing on stone as if in a ricefield, steady, waiting to hear whether she is to be sent to the terraces. Tenant-farmer's brown forearms.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a stone stair, feet apart, hands folded in front of her as if still in a rice paddy, calm and honest, waiting to hear whether she will be sent to the terraces. Face: most important, her bare forearms, deeply browned and sinewy, a tenant-farmer's, shown below rolled sleeves in the lower frame. It is a broad, plain, sun-browned face with calm, clear, dark eyes, straight dark brows, a flat nose and a wide, patient mouth; the cheekbones are sun-darkened, and a thin line of white shows at the hairline where her hat usually sits. Hair: black, tied in a plain tail with a straw cord, the ends bleached lighter by the sun. Body: stocky and solid, planted wide. Clothing: a plain undyed grey outer-gate robe of good cloth, clean, with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, a short black rain cape and a black sash. Hands and objects: both brown forearms crossed in front of her; a small straw hat hangs on a cord at her back. A plain straight double-edged sword in a green-stained scabbard is slung diagonally across the back; its dark wood guard and the grip wrapped in bark-brown cord show above the right shoulder. Background: a grey stone stair, wet rice terraces beyond, mist. Light: a broad, soft, even grey light from the upper left that shows every honest line of the face. Expression: calm and patient, an unguarded honesty, the open look of someone who has never learned to hide what she thinks.

people.imagined: By the outer gate's stoves, a stove-poker on his shoulder, sleepy and smiling. He wants nothing more.
people.subject: The moment: leaning on a stove with an iron poker over his shoulder, half asleep and smiling. Face: most important, an iron stove-poker, its tip glowing dull red, resting over his shoulder, and a sleepy contented smile. A round, sleepy, soot-smudged face; half-closed, warm, brown eyes; soft low brows; a blunt nose; a lazy smile. A faint smudge of ash marks one cheek and a dimple sits at the corner of the smile. Hair: black, a ruffled mess with ash in it. A flake of ash rests on the top of his head, and the whole mass of hair is pushed up on one side as if he has just been asleep. Body: round, comfortable, slouched. Clothing: a plain undyed grey outer-gate robe, ash-dusted but whole, a short black rain cape, a black sash, a cloth apron. Hands and objects: the poker held lightly in one hand over his shoulder, its tip dull red; the other hand scratching his neck. Background: a stone kitchen, glowing stove mouths, a kettle. A row of iron kettles hangs above the stove and a bundle of kindling leans against the wall. Light: warm orange light from the right and below. Expression: Heavy sleepy lids, a lazy, easy smile, his cheek resting loose against the poker.

people.imagined: Waiting for a storm, clacking an iron bracelet against a copper one, impatient, sure her Fire and Metal will meet.
people.subject: The moment: waiting for a storm with her arms crossed, she clacks an iron bracelet against a copper bracelet on her wrist, looking up at the sky, impatient and sure her Fire and Metal will meet. Face: most important, an iron bracelet and a copper bracelet side by side on her bare wrist, the dull iron and bright copper clearly seen against each other. It is a strong, sharp, brave, sun-brown face with bright, fierce, amber eyes, thick arched brows, a straight nose and a firm, impatient mouth; a thin scar nicks the left corner of her upper lip, and her lashes are singed short. Hair: black, in a thick high tail tied with a red cord. Body: lean, strong and restless, weight on one foot and one hip pushed out, the very picture of waiting. Clothing: a plain undyed grey outer-gate robe of good cloth with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, a short black oiled-silk rain cloak and a black sash. Hands and objects: the left wrist wears the dull iron band and the bright copper band, clacked against each other. A plain short slim sword in a red-brown scabbard is slung diagonally across the back; its copper guard and the grip wrapped in rust-red cord show above the right shoulder. Background: a dark purple storm sky and the smoke of a charcoal-burner's kiln. Light: cold storm light from the upper left; a lightning flicker far off makes the bracelets flash white for an instant. Expression: impatient and bold, a hopeful, challenging lift of the chin toward the sky.

people.imagined: In the coast house counting room, a ledger-ruler tucked behind her ear, salt in her eyebrows, keeping two sets of books.
people.subject: The moment: in the counting room of a coast house she looks up from her desk with a careful, neutral face, a long wooden ruler tucked behind one ear, keeping two sets of books. Face: most important, a long flat wooden ruler stuck behind her right ear, and white salt crystals caught in her eyebrows. It is a neat, thin, sallow face with careful, light grey eyes, salt-white brows, a small nose, and a mouth held tidy and closed. Hair: dark brown, in a flat bun held with a small hair-stick of bleached driftwood, a trace of white salt on it.
