Body: thin and narrow-shouldered, sitting upright with elbows in, perfectly composed, knees together under the desk. Clothing: a plain undyed grey outer-gate robe, immaculate, a short black rain cape with salt dried on the hem, and a black sash. Hands and objects: an ink brush held upright in the right hand; the left rests on two thick books stacked on the desk. Slung across the back, past the left shoulder rises the hilt of a plain narrow straight sword with a faint damp sheen, its grip wrapped in salt-stiffened grey twine, a flat bar guard with a notch, a scabbard of black oilskin over wood whitened with salt at the seams, and a small cork float on a line at the pommel. Background: shelves of ledgers in grey cloth covers, each tied with a different coloured cord, and a window with a grey sea and gulls. Light: cool daylight from the upper left, with a glint of salt in the brows and on the hem. Expression: careful and bland, a face smoothed over with deliberate blankness, hiding.

people.imagined: At the mine, pocket full of pebbles shaped like faces; his honest face tells you the rest.
people.subject: The moment: at a mine entrance he pats a bulging pocket that clicks, his face transparent, honest and guilty, like a boy who has been caught. Face: most important, a bulging pocket full of pale pebbles, and in his palm held out toward the viewer one pebble with a natural face-like shape. It is a mild, open, round face with wide honest brown eyes, light upturned brows, a short nose and a worried, gentle mouth; a wide smear of pale clay marks the left cheek, and his ears turn red when he is nervous. Hair: black and tousled, a pebble caught in it. Body: slight and round-shouldered, his weight on both heels and his arms held a little out from his sides. Clothing: a plain undyed grey outer-gate robe, dusty from the mine, a short black rain cape and a black sash; one pocket is stitched larger than the other, bulging. Hands and objects: the right palm holds a pale pebble with natural eye-holes and a mouth-line like a small face; the left hand pats the pocket. Slung across the back, past the right shoulder rises the hilt of a plain straight double-edged sword, its grip wrapped in dark hemp, a flat teardrop guard of grey iron, a scabbard of dark leather bulging at the mouth where a pebble is jammed, and a face-shaped pebble wired to the scabbard strap. Background: a rainy mine entrance of dark timber and a pile of rocks. Light: soft grey light from the upper left, a thin film of light on the wet pebbles giving each a tiny shine. Expression: honest and humble, a guilty flinch he cannot hide, the mouth a little open to confess.

people.imagined: Bowing exactly a hand's depth to an elder, counting steps. He wants the Hall of Rules and knows every rule.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a doorway in an exact bow, back flat, head lowered a hand's depth, then looking up, counting his steps; he wants the Hall of Rules and knows every rule. Face: most important, a precisely measured bow of the head to a hand's depth, the back flat. It is a narrow, pale, correct face with calm, precise dark eyes, level even brows, a straight nose and a flat closed mouth; a faint pale line from a cap-string crosses the forehead. Hair: black, combed flat and tied in a tight small knot, not a hair out of place, bound in a square wrap of black thread. Body: thin, upright and rigid. Clothing: a plain undyed grey outer-gate robe, pressed and clean without a single crease in the collar, a black oiled-silk rain cape folded in exact thirds over one arm, and a black sash tied square. Hands and objects: both hands pressed flat on his thighs; at his belt a wooden counting-bead string. Slung across the back, past the right shoulder rises the hilt of a plain slim jian, its grip wrapped in neat grey silk cord in exactly even turns, a plain thin round guard, a scabbard of grey lacquered wood hung dead straight, and a single small grey knot centred on the pommel. Background: the plain doorway of a stern hall, a water clock dripping in the shadow. Light: a flat white light from the doorway showing every line of his straight posture, with no shadow. Expression: correct and still, serious, the faint tension of a boy who fears only that he has miscounted.

people.imagined: Sweeping the old tower's stair, wet broom, wet sleeves, a damp pigtail dripping down her back.
people.subject: The moment: sweeping a wet stair, she pauses with the broom and looks up with a gentle, devout, trusting smile. Face: most important, a damp pigtail dripping water down her back and a wet broom of twigs in her hands. A small, round, soft, dewy face; large, calm, dark eyes; fine brows; a small nose; a gentle smile. Hair: black, in a long wet braid dripping, tied with a green ribbon. A few wet strands cling to her cheek and neck, and the green ribbon at the end of the braid is dark with water. Body: small, thin, light. Her shoulders are narrow and a little bowed from sweeping, and she stands with feet together, toes slightly turned in. Clothing: a plain undyed grey outer-gate robe, wet at the cuffs and hem, a short black rain cape, a black sash. Her sleeves are knotted up above the elbow with twine, the grey hem is dark with wet to the knee, and her sandals are tied with strips of rag. Hands and objects: both hands on a long broom of bound twigs; water drops fall from the bristles. A plain short slim sword in a blue-black scabbard is slung diagonally across the back; its pewter guard and the grip wrapped in pale blue cord show above the left shoulder. Background: a grey old stone stair, a bronze chain dripping, misty lake path. Light: soft grey light from the upper left. A pale halo of misty light rings her head, and droplets glitter on the broom's twigs. Expression: A gentle, trusting smile, eyes upturned and soft, a damp strand stuck to her cheek.

people.imagined: One pace behind his master, copying his limp, looking at the red names on a sleeve and wanting to ask.
people.subject: The moment: walking half-turned, one leg dragging in imitation, he looks at a sleeve out of frame, wanting to ask. Face: most important, a deliberately copied limping stride, one shoulder dropped, an eager, hungry look. A square, hot, young face; bright, hungry, dark eyes; thick, intense brows; a short nose; a tight mouth. A thin pale scar nicks his chin, and a rim of sweat shines on his upper lip as he copies the limp. Hair: black, tied up in a hard topknot just like a duellist's. Body: stocky, strong, a forced swagger. His left shoulder dips with each step and the left leg drags a little behind, exactly as he has seen it done by his master, though it is not his own. Clothing: a plain undyed grey outer-gate robe, clean, a short black rain cape, a black sash; a tiny red thread stitched on his own sleeve, a single small stitch. A hard, high topknot copies a duellist's, held by a black iron pin that is too large for him and has a small notch bent in it. Hands and objects: the right hand on a plain sword hilt; the left raised to point at a sleeve. Background: a rainy yard, the back of a tall man in a black cloak blurred. Light: grey light from the upper left. A cold grey drizzle-light lies along the wet flagstones and shows his stiff figure in sharp outline. Expression: eager, ambitious, avid.

people.imagined: Weaving a basket with quick fingers, apricot sash on, holding the best fruit back for a buyer who pays double. She means to wait for her Metal.
people.subject: The moment: weaving a basket with fast fingers, glancing sideways, a secretive smile. Face: most important, an apricot-orange sash tied bright at her waist, and her fingers a blur of weaving. A small, clever, round face; sharp, pale brown eyes in a sideways glance; thin, arched brows; a small nose; a small, tight, patient smile. A tiny crease marks the space between her brows, and a faint dusting of freckles runs across the bridge of her nose. Hair: dark brown, in a neat coil with a wooden pin. Body: small, slim, neat. She sits with her knees together and her back straight, elbows close to her sides, her whole stance patient as a cat watching a mouse-hole. Clothing: a plain undyed grey outer-gate robe, a short black rain cape, an apricot-orange silk sash, a wicker basket on her lap. Hands and objects: both hands weaving thin willow strips into a basket; a few ripe apricots hidden under a cloth at her side. Her fingers are long and quick, the nails short, and a long cut of willow lies across her lap, pale green and wet. A plain short slim sword with a faint violet gleam in the edge, its grip wrapped in plaited pale-straw cane in a basket weave, a small plain round iron guard, a scabbard of black wood wrapped in wicker, and a short tassel of apricot thread is slung diagonally across the back, its hilt showing above the left shoulder. Background: a dim stall with baskets, hanging fruit. Light: warm light from the upper left. A band of orange afternoon light slants through the stall front and warms the wicker strips. Expression: patient, calculating, secretive.

people.imagined: Wearing a dented old captain's helmet as a rain-pot at the gate, honest and stubborn. His family kept the helmet and nothing else.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a gate in rain with a battered iron helmet on his head, water running off its dented crown, solemn. Face: most important, a dented old iron helmet with a flat crest, a deep dent on one side and rust at the rim, worn on his head. A strong, square, boyish, honest face under it; steady, dark, brave eyes; thick brows; a broad nose; a firm, closed mouth, with a faint red-brown fuzz on the lip. A thin rain-streak of rust from the helmet's rim runs down his temple like a tear, and his chin has a faint cleft. Hair: red-brown, wet, poking out under the helmet. Body: sturdy, square-shouldered. He stands with his heels together and his shoulders square, the posture of a boy who has been told his ancestor's name many times. Clothing: a plain undyed grey outer-gate robe, a black oiled-silk rain cloak, a black sash. Under the black rain cloak the grey robe is slightly short in the sleeve, showing his thin wrists, and a strip of red cloth is tied round the left forearm. Hands and objects: both hands hold a plain sword upright; rain collects in the helmet's dent. Background: a grey wooden gate, falling rain, a blurred path. Light: cold grey light from the upper left. A pale grey light slides off the wet iron of the helmet and gleams on the sword hilt. Expression: A solemn, proud set to the mouth with the chin lifted under the dented helm, eyes straight ahead and honest, rain running down his face.

people.imagined: Panning the drill ground for gold dust, the pan-hand trembling, making a smaller boy carry the pan home.
people.subject: The moment: crouched over a flat pan with a trembling hand, eyes greedily bright. Face: most important, a shallow pan of wet sand with a few bright gold specks in it held in his shaking hand, and fine gold dust under every nail. A sly, round, sunburnt face; shiny, quick, light-brown eyes; thin brows; a button nose; a half-open, eager mouth. A smear of grey mud marks his chin and one dimple shows even in his greedy half-smile. Hair: sandy brown, a messy fringe. Body: plump, loose. He is hunched on his heels with his elbows on his knees, the belly spilling slightly over the sash. Clothing: a plain undyed grey outer-gate robe, muddy at the knees, a short black rain cape, a black sash. The hem and sleeves of his robe are stiff with dried mud, and in the sash a small cloth bag is tied, bulging with something heavy. Hands and objects: the right hand holding the pan, trembling so the sand shivers; the left hand with gold-dust nails pointing at a speck. Slung across the back, past the left shoulder rises the hilt of a plain short slim sword, its grip wrapped in fine pale sand-coloured cord, a small plain guard with gold dust in its pits, a scabbard of dun hide that glitters faintly with gold, and a pinch of gold dust sealed in a wax pill on the pommel cord. Background: a wet drill yard, puddles, a few blurred figures. Light: grey light from the upper left, a glint of gold. A thin line of white light from a cloud gap lights the wet sand and a speck of gold in it like a star. Expression: Eyes bright and greedy, a sly, lazy smirk and a lowered head as he hunches over the pan.

people.imagined: A beat after a joke, he grins, a chipped front tooth. At the front of every climb.
people.subject: The moment: a slow, late grin spreads across his face a beat after a joke, a chipped front tooth showing, at the front of every climb. Face: most important, one chipped front tooth, a half-moon gone from the corner, in a broad late grin. It is a big, broad, plain, red-cheeked face with small, loyal brown eyes, thick brows and a wide flat nose; the ears are thick and slightly cauliflowered, and the smile lingers at the corner of the mouth as if the joke were still being turned over. Hair: black, cropped dense, with a small bald spot at the crown where a rope once burned it. Body: enormous shoulders and a thick neck as wide as his head, the trapezius rising in two steep slopes to his ears; the strongest boy of his year. Clothing: a plain undyed grey outer-gate robe of good cloth, drawn tight across the shoulders, a short black rain cape, a black sash. Hands and objects: a thick iron chain link with a bite mark in it in the right hand; the left hand scratches his head. Slung across the back, past the left shoulder rises the hilt of a plain straight double-edged sword, its grip thick and bound in black leather, a heavy squared iron cross guard with one arm bent by a blow, a scabbard of pitch-black oak banded in iron, and a bent chain link on a cord, a link he once bit through. Background: a grey drill yard, a drum post. Light: flat soft grey light from the upper left, giving the chain link a dull shine. Expression: slow, loyal and cheerful, an easy, unhurried good humour.

people.imagined: A miner's daughter, a thunder-glass bead swinging at her neck, due to walk into the inner gate this spring and worshipping Khúc Thanh Điện.
people.subject: The moment: arms folded, chin lifted, a violet glass bead swinging at her neck, a miner's daughter confident that this spring she walks into the inner gate. Face: most important, a violet thunder-glass bead on a cord swinging against her chest, and thick miner's wrists below crossed arms. It is a strong, bright, tanned face with keen, dark, ambitious eyes, strong arched brows, a straight nose, and a wide confident smile with a tiny gap between the front teeth; freckles dust her cheeks and the tip of her nose. Hair: black, in a high tail as thick as a rope tied with a violet cord, a few short curls sticking out round the ears. Body: broad-shouldered, feet set wide and weight low, a miner's solid stance. Clothing: a plain undyed grey outer-gate robe of good cloth with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, a short black rain cape, a black sash. Hands and objects: arms crossed; the bead hanging from its cord. A plain short slim sword with a faint violet gleam in the edge, its grip wrapped in black cord, a plain ring guard, a scabbard of grey-black lacquer, and a loop of braided miner's lamp-wick over the guard is slung diagonally across the back, its hilt showing above the right shoulder. Background: a mine yard with violet crystals piled in a cart, a grey sky. Light: bright grey light from the upper left, a glint of violet running along each thunder-glass crystal in the cart and lighting the bead at her neck. Expression: confident and ambitious, bright with the eager certainty of someone who has already pictured herself a step higher.

people.imagined: Walking behind his uncle along the ridge with the drumstick's case strapped across his back like a bow. He has counted where it hums.
people.subject: The moment: walking along a ridge, a long lacquered case strapped diagonally across his back like a bow, head cocked, listening to a hum. Face: most important, a long black lacquered drumstick case strapped diagonally across his back, rising over one shoulder. A quiet, mild, narrow face; humble, attentive, dark eyes; level brows; a straight nose; a small, patient mouth. His lashes are pale, his lips thin and often moving as if counting, and a small mole sits just below the right eye. Hair: black, tied in a short knot. The knot is small and neat, with a strip of brown cloth round it, and the nape shows a pale scar from a childhood fall. Body: lean, upright, steady. He walks a pace behind an unseen uncle, shoulders level, the case riding squarely on his spine. Clothing: a plain undyed grey outer-gate robe, a black oiled-silk rain cloak, a black sash. Hands and objects: the right hand lifted by his ear, listening; the strap crossing his chest. Slung across the back, past the right shoulder rises the hilt of a plain narrow straight sword, its grip wrapped in oiled gut strip, a narrow plain bar guard, a scabbard of black lacquered leather hung beside the drumstick case, and a scrap of drumskin tied at the pommel. Background: a misty ridge path, pines, a faint far flash. Light: soft grey light from the upper left. A flat grey light and a thin white mist make his dark case gleam like wet lacquer. Expression: Head cocked, eyes lifted and attentive, lips slightly open, a humble look of listening to something far off.

people.imagined: Beneath the founder's rain-chain at the Rain Tower, oiling the nine bronze cups, polishing the cup at her own neck as she talks. She will sit beneath it with her sword if anyone comes to take it down.
people.subject: The moment: standing under a long bronze rain-chain, one hand polishing a bronze cup at her neck with a cloth while she looks at the viewer firmly. Face: most important, a small bronze rain-cup hung at her throat on a cord, rubbed bright, and above her the hanging chain of nine cups. A square, firm, fair-brown face; steady, dark, defiant eyes; straight dark brows; a short straight nose; a firm, closed mouth. Hair: black, in a tight bun with a bronze pin. Body: sturdy, straight, planted. She plants her feet a shoulder-width apart and holds her spine like a drawn bow, as if she might sit down at any moment beneath the chain and not get up. Clothing: a black oiled-silk rain cloak, clean and oiled to a gloss, an undyed grey robe with a high collar, a black sash. Hands and objects: a small cloth in the right hand rubbing the cup at her neck; the left hand rests on a plain sword at her hip; behind her a long chain of nine bronze cups hanging from eaves. Background: grey tower eaves, rain, a misty hill. Light: soft grey light from the upper left, bronze gleams. A pale shaft of light falls through the eaves and picks out each of the nine bronze cups in turn. Expression: firm, loyal, unyielding.

people.imagined: Weighing grain in the cistern yard, a scale-beam tattooed on his wrist, grain dust in the creases of his neck, taking the tenants' seed barley by the book.
people.subject: The moment: at a grain scale he lifts one wrist to show a tattoo and looks calmly at the viewer, by the book. Face: most important, a small black scale-beam tattoo on the inside of his left wrist, plain and bold as he rests the wrist on the scale. A round, smooth, comfortable face; calm, dull, grey-brown eyes; neat brows; a small nose; a tidy, closed, neutral mouth; grain dust in the creases of the neck. A faint lengthwise crease marks each cheek, and a drop of sweat sits at the temple though the day is cool. Hair: dark, thinning, combed flat. A grey streak crosses the left side and the topknot is held with a plain black wooden pin. Body: stout, soft, settled. He stands with feet together and belly forward, hands never far from the scale, a clerk's careful balance. Clothing: a black oiled-silk rain cloak, neat, an undyed grey robe, grain-dusted cuffs, a black sash. Hands and objects: the left wrist on a wooden balance with two pans, one with barley; the right holds a measuring scoop. Background: sacks of barley stacked, a stone cistern, soft rain. Light: soft grey light from the upper left, a dusty haze. A hazy light stirs the grain dust into gold motes that hang about him. Expression: bland, correct, unyielding.

people.imagined: At the oars on the lake, rowing a burial out to the withered lotus, her hands never shaking, a mourning-white cord at her wrist.
people.subject: The moment: rowing across a misty lake with steady oars, her eyes on the far lotus, a white cord at her wrist. Face: most important, a white mourning cord knotted round her left wrist, bright against grey. A solemn, calm, pale face; dark, steady, grieving eyes; straight brows; a straight nose; a closed, quiet mouth. Wet strands cling to her cheek, and a small pale scar sits at her chin. Hair: black, tied back plainly, a white cord at the knot. The white cord is wound twice round her knot and the two ends hang down at her nape, stirring in the breeze. Body: strong, balanced at the oars, shoulders level. She sits upright on the thwart, her back never touching anything, the oars held level in a perfect line. Clothing: a black oiled-silk rain cloak, an undyed grey robe, sleeves pushed up, a black sash. Hands and objects: both hands wrapped round wooden oar handles, the palms thick with callus, perfectly steady; a white cord at the wrist. Slung across the back, past the left shoulder rises the hilt of a well-made straight double-edged sword with a faint damp bloom on the steel, its grip wrapped in wet-darkened oar-lashing hemp, a flat guard shaped like a tiny oar-blade of tarnished iron, a scabbard of dark green-black lotus-leaf lacquer, and a dried lotus seed on the pommel cord. Background: a grey lake, withered pale lotus leaves, a faint shape of a long bundle in the boat. Light: soft grey light from the upper left. A pale silver shine lies on the lake, and a gleam on the wet oar blades. Expression: grave, steady, reverent.

people.imagined: Walking along the Iron Rain chain, tapping each link with a hammer, listening for the one that rings wrong.
people.subject: The moment: bending from the waist to tap an iron chain link with a small hammer, head cocked to listen for the one link that rings wrong. Face: most important, a small hammer raised to tap an iron chain link, and his ear turned toward the chain. It is a thin, leathery, long face, grey with age and soot, with narrow, careful, pale eyes, heavy grey brows, a long nose, and a thin, patient mouth; soot has gathered in the deep creases of the forehead, and the stubble is white at the chin and black at the cheek. Hair: iron-grey, in a thin short tail, a cloth bound round the head. Body: lean, bent and long-armed, one hand on his knee, patient as a heron. Clothing: a black oiled-silk rain cloak scorched at the hem, an undyed grey robe with black cuffs, and a leather apron, cracked and stiff with years of forge dust and mended on the front with a square of newer leather, which is the honest wear of a smith's working life; his sleeves are held back with copper wire. Hands and objects: a small iron hammer in the right hand; the left hand grips a thick iron chain running out of the frame. Slung across the back, past the left shoulder rises the hilt of a well-made straight double-edged sword, its grip wound in fine drawn bronze wire of his own making, a heavy square guard of dark iron, a scabbard of black iron-bound oak, and a single chain link that rings against the guard when he walks. Background: a long iron chain running along a ridge into mist under a dark sky. Light: cold grey light from the upper left, a cold sheen along the links ending in a point of white where the hammer is about to fall. Expression: attentive and patient, the unhurried look of a man listening.

people.imagined: Night in the soul vaults, hair pinned up with a wick-trimmer, owl-wide pupils, knowing each lamp by its flicker.
people.subject: The moment: in a dim vault at night with huge dark pupils, a wick-trimmer pinned through her hair, looking toward a flickering lamp. Face: most important, her pupils are enormous, almost filling the irises like an owl's, and a pair of small brass wick-trimming scissors thrust through her hair-knot. A pale, thin, narrow face; owl-wide dark eyes; thin brows; a small straight nose; a soft, tired mouth. A fine line from the nose to each corner of the mouth shows late nights, and her lashes are short and straight. Hair: black, piled in a knot, the brass scissors pinned in. Body: slight, thin, still. She stands with her weight on the left foot, the right foot turned out, perfectly still, as if she were a lamp stand herself. Clothing: a black oiled-silk rain cloak, an undyed grey robe, ink-dark cuffs, a black sash. Hands and objects: a small lamp with a wavering flame held at chest height in both hands; behind her shelves of tiny lamps in rows, glowing. In her belt hangs a leather case of spare wicks, and the fingertips of the right hand are black with wick soot. Background: a dim vault of rows of small lamps. Light: warm flickering light from the lamps, deep shadow. The lamp's glow trembles, and the flame is reflected twice in each of her wide pupils. Expression: watchful, tired, haunted.

people.imagined: Rolling dice in a harbour tavern, losing carefully with an easy smile, a tooth missing, listening to the crews.
people.subject: The moment: in a tavern he throws dice with an easy, loser's smile, a front tooth missing, his ears alert. Face: most important, a missing front tooth showing as a dark gap in an easy, friendly smile, and callus-rough fingertips. A friendly, open, craggy face; twinkling, bright, brown eyes, a little too attentive; loose brows; a crooked nose; a wide smile with a gap. A day's grey stubble shadows his jaw, and one eyebrow has a small notch cut in it by an old dice-quarrel. Hair: black, tousled, a small gold ring in one ear. A twist of red thread binds the black tail, and a stray lock falls over one eye. Body: loose, relaxed, easygoing. He slouches against the table with one elbow on it, loose and easy, ready to laugh at his own bad luck. Clothing: a black oiled-silk rain cloak worn loose, an undyed grey robe, an open collar, a black sash. Hands and objects: the right hand open, releasing two white dice in the air; the fingertips of the left hand rough and calloused from dice. A well-made narrow straight sword with no obvious wear, its grip covered in soft grey eel-skin, a slim bar guard worn bare, a scabbard of dark fish-oiled leather, and a single small bone die with the six worn flat tied at the pommel by a thread is slung diagonally across the back, its hilt showing above the right shoulder. Background: a smoky tavern, blurred sailors, a lamp. Light: warm lamplight from the upper left. The tavern lamp throws a warm swinging glow on the dice, which tumble in the air like small white moons. Expression: easy, cheerful, listening.

people.imagined: Reading a charge in the dark by heart, eyes half closed, his voice lower than the water clock. He adds or drops a clause as the clock drips.
people.subject: The moment: in a dark hall with his eyes half closed, he recites by heart, mouth barely moving, a water clock dripping beside him. Face: most important, eyes half closed to slits and lips barely moving, a voice you can see being very low. A long, grey, solemn face, deeply lined; half-closed, heavy-lidded eyes; thick grey brows; a long nose; a long, thin, still mouth; a pointed grey beard. The skin around his eyes is thin and slightly bluish, and his long upper lip hardly moves as the words pass over it. Hair: grey, tied in a severe topknot. A small black cap sits on the topknot, and the grey at the temples is combed in hard lines. Body: tall, thin, upright, stiff. He stands like a post, neither leaning nor swaying, shoulders level, hands clasped low in front of his belt. Clothing: a black oiled-silk rain cloak, an undyed grey robe of fine cloth with a stiff high collar, a black sash. Hands and objects: both hands folded in front, empty; a small water clock dripping in the background. Background: a dark hall, a single lamp, a water clock. Light: dim lamplight from the lower left, deep shadow. The drip of the clock throws a small ripple of reflected light on the wall behind his shoulder. Expression: solemn, remote, unreadable.

people.imagined: On the storm climb, rain streaming, calves like rope, a face nothing bothers. He kept his pace when a boy's ankle broke.
people.subject: The moment: climbing in a storm, rain streaming down an impassive face, mid-stride. Face: most important, rain streaming down a calm, unbothered face, the calves like rope visible below in a rolled trouser leg at the frame edge. A long, lean, weathered face; flat, calm, dark eyes; level brows; a long nose; a mouth like a closed door. A line of grey mud streaks his jaw, and the bone of his cheek stands high and sharp. Hair: black, plastered flat, tied in a short tail. A twist of sodden cord holds the black tail, and strands are plastered across his neck. Body: lean, rangy, rope-muscled. Clothing: a black oiled-silk rain cloak flapping, an undyed grey robe hitched up, a black sash. Hands and objects: a rope in the right hand; the left arm swinging as in a climb. A coil of wet rope runs over his left shoulder, and each of his hands is wrapped in a strip of grey cloth, the knuckles bare. Slung across the back, past the right shoulder rises the hilt of a well-made narrow straight sword, its grip wrapped in pitch-black weather-proofed cord, a small plain cross guard of iron, a scabbard of black lacquered cypress strapped twice to the back for the climb with a pale scar of stripped lacquer where lightning ran along it. Background: a steep wet peak path, a roaring storm sky. Light: cold white storm light from the upper left. Rain lines flash white past a livid sky, and each lightning pulse shows his set jaw in hard edges. Expression: impassive, steady, unbothered.

people.imagined: At the market weighing stall, a bone abacus at her belt, a bracelet of weights chiming. She pockets the copper tip and would like it noticed she took up the abacus.
people.subject: The moment: at a market weighing stall, she shakes a wrist so a bracelet of little weights chimes, eyes on the viewer. Face: most important, a bracelet of many tiny bronze weights on her wrist, shaken so they chime, and a bone abacus at her belt. A sharp, handsome, brown face; bright, appraising, dark eyes; sharply arched brows; a straight nose; a thin, pleased mouth with a small smirk. A little rouge touches her lips, and a tiny gold stud shines at the left nostril. Hair: black, in a high smooth knot with a bone comb. Body: slim, straight, quick. She stands with a long straight back and one hip cocked, chin lifted like a seller of fine goods. Clothing: a black oiled-silk rain cloak, an undyed grey robe of fine cloth, a black sash with a bone abacus hung at it. Her grey robe is edged at the collar with a thin line of red thread, the sleeves are wide, and the black sash is knotted in a neat loop at the left hip. Hands and objects: the right wrist lifted, wearing a jingling bracelet of tiny weights; the left hand hovers over a small balance. Background: a night market stall, lanterns, hanging goods. Light: warm lantern light from the upper left. Each small bronze weight on her wrist throws a golden spark in the lantern glow. Expression: shrewd, proud, quietly greedy.

people.imagined: Sorting pebbles at the mine, a pebble tucked in her cheek that she thinks no one has noticed.
people.subject: The moment: sorting pebbles on a tray, one cheek bulging, trying to look innocent. Face: most important, one cheek bulging round like a hamster's with a pebble held in her mouth. A round, tanned, innocent-looking face; wide, sly, brown eyes; thin brows; a button nose; closed lips, one cheek puffed. A pale line of dust runs across her forehead, and her lashes are thick and dark, giving the guilty eyes a solemn look. Hair: black, in two small buns. A loose strand falls between the two small buns, and each bun is tied with plain brown thread. Body: small, round-shouldered. She stoops over the tray with her round shoulders high and her elbows on the table, ready to swallow in a hurry. Clothing: a black oiled-silk rain cloak, an undyed grey robe, sleeves rolled, a black sash. Hands and objects: both hands on a tray of sorted small pebbles in rows; one finger resting on a pale flower-shaped pebble. Beside the tray, a small clay dish holds the rejected pebbles, grey and chipped. Slung across the back, past the left shoulder rises the hilt of a well-made long straight sword, its grip covered in shingled pale grey ray-skin, a smooth plain guard of grey iron, a scabbard of dark wood, and a flat grey rain-flower pebble set in the pommel cap. Background: a mine shed, a table, rain at a window. Light: soft grey light from the upper left. A pale rainy light falls from the window across the stones on the tray, each pebble a soft round highlight. Expression: innocent, secretive, comic.

people.imagined: At the vault door, back to it, one hand on the latch which has twice come off in his hand. He wants to be taught Thunder.
people.subject: The moment: standing with his back flat against a heavy iron door, holding up a loose iron latch that has come off in his hand for the second time, comically detached; he wants to be taught Thunder. Face: most important, an iron door latch lying loose in his raised hand, wrenched off, held up toward the viewer. It is a square, dutiful, plain face with earnest, dark, anxious eyes, thick brows, a short nose and a pressed, hopeful mouth; a line of worry runs between his brows, and a smudge of rust from the latch marks his thumb and chin. Hair: black, in a short neat topknot tied with black cord, one stray strand sticking out. Body: broad and sturdy, pressing his back flat against the door as if holding it shut with his whole frame, heels together, chin tucked. Clothing: a black oiled-silk rain cloak, an undyed grey robe of good cloth, and a black sash. Hands and objects: the right hand holds the loose iron door-latch; the left rests on the door. Background: a heavy black iron door, a stone corridor, a dim lamp. Light: dim yellow light from a single lamp at the upper left, casting a long soft shadow of his figure up the iron door, and a glint on the latch. Expression: earnest and a little embarrassed, loyal, a sheepish wish to be forgiven.

people.imagined: Pinning a paper to the Hall of Rules' door again, her jaw set. Ink on her left sleeve.
people.subject: The moment: pressing a folded paper against a door with one hand, jaw tight, glaring. Face: most important, a left sleeve smeared black with ink and a square, set jaw. A sharp, fair, determined face; bright, angry, dark eyes; strong straight brows; a straight nose; a firm, tight mouth. A faint ink-fleck marks her cheekbone and her lips are pressed so firmly that the edges go white. Hair: black, in a tight knot with a wooden pin. Body: slim, upright. She stands on tiptoe with her arm raised, shoulder set, a deliberate, defiant stretch. Clothing: a black oiled-silk rain cloak, an undyed grey robe with an ink-black left sleeve, a black sash; a folded paper at the belt. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a blank folded paper pressed to a grey door with a small iron pin. A small iron pin is pressed between her left finger and thumb, and a coil of string and a second fold of paper are tucked in her belt. A well-made straight double-edged sword in a blue-black scabbard is slung diagonally across the back; its pewter guard and the grip wrapped in pale blue cord show above the right shoulder. Background: a dark timber door, rain, a blurred hall. Light: cold grey light from the upper left. A hard grey light lies flat on the door, with sharp shadows under the pin and the edge of the paper. Expression: A defiant, tight jaw, a steady glare and lips pressed flat as she holds the paper to the door.

people.imagined: Eyes following other men's swords, ore-hauler's sloping shoulders, passing a note to the Thunder Hall.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a rainy yard, his eyes following a sword out of frame with a hungry, envious stare. Face: most important, heavy sloping ore-hauler's shoulders and a gaze fixed hard on a blade out of frame. It is a broad, bony, brown face with sharp, hungry, narrow eyes, heavy brows, a flat nose, and a thin, tight mouth; a day's stubble darkens the lean jaw, and one brow sits higher than the other as he watches the blade pass. Hair: black, in a rough short tail held by a plain strip of leather, with dust from the ore road lying in it. Body: thick, sloping shoulders and long arms, his weight forward on the balls of his feet, the hands never still, the fingers flexing as if to take the sword himself. Clothing: a black oiled-silk rain cloak, an undyed grey robe of fine cloth, and a black sash. Hands and objects: the right hand on a plain sword hilt; the left holds a small folded paper he means to pass to the Thunder Hall. Background: a rainy yard with a few blurred swordsmen. Light: cool grey light from the upper left, falling across the wet yard and gleaming along the distant blades. Expression: hungry and eager, a tight envy at the corners of the mouth, the look of a man who wants what he is watching.

people.imagined: On the mule road, talking to his stick, a barley-sack hat on his head, counting his remaining trips. His old mule eats one sack in thirty.
people.subject: The moment: on a mule road at midday, leaning on a stick and talking to it, a hat of coarse barley sacking on his head, counting his remaining trips. Face: most important, a floppy hat made of barley-sack cloth, crudely stitched, and a thick knobbed walking stick held up to his mouth as he mutters to it. It is a very old, lined, brown face like old leather, with small twinkling pale eyes, white bushy brows, a bulbous nose with large pores and fine veins, a toothless muttering mouth and white stubble; a single long white hair grows from the left ear. Hair: white wisps below the hat. Body: bent, small and bandy-legged, stooping forward over the stick with the knees slightly bent, bare brown ankles showing above his sandals. Clothing: a clean black oiled-silk rain cloak and an undyed grey robe of good cloth, a rope belt tied with a loose bow, and a barley husk stuck to one sleeve. Hands and objects: a knobbed stick held in both hands, with a row of notches cut along it; at the edge of the frame a mule's nose pushes in. Background: a dirt mule road, barley sacks, misty hills. Light: soft grey light from the upper left, showing the dust on the road and each fibre of the sacking hat. Expression: muttering and wily, a toothless, affectionate cunning, as if the stick were an old friend who just gave good advice.

people.imagined: Teaching the drop-counting drill, a slow blink, a pebble bag at his hip. He drills his little sister harder than the rest.
people.subject: The moment: standing before a class, he blinks slowly in the drop-counter's way while holding up a small pebble. Face: most important, an unhurried slow blink, eyes half closed, and a small bag of pebbles at his hip. A calm, long, patient face, pale brown; half-lidded, steady, dark eyes; level brows; a straight nose; a firm, closed mouth. His brow is smooth and his eyes have faint creases at the corners from long watching, and a small scar notches his chin. Hair: black, tied in a plain knot. The knot is tied with a strip of grey cloth, and a few grey hairs show at the temples. Body: lean, upright, composed. He stands with his weight even on both feet and his shoulders level, a teacher's patient poise. Clothing: a black oiled-silk rain cloak, an undyed grey robe of fine cloth, a black sash with a cloth bag of pebbles hung from it. Hands and objects: the right hand holds up a smooth pebble between thumb and finger; the left hand rests on the pebble bag. Slung across the back, past the left shoulder rises the hilt of a well-made slim jian, its grip wrapped in grey thread laid slowly in even rows, a round guard of old dull pewter, a scabbard of straw-pale split bamboo, and a small leather pebble pouch tied to the scabbard strap. Background: a rain-chain hanging, drops falling, blurred children in a line. Light: soft grey light from the upper left. A soft light falls on the hand holding the pebble so that it casts a round shadow on his palm. Expression: patient, firm, controlled.

people.imagined: Sweeping the founder's cistern, forearms like a stair-sweeper's, hem always wet, glad to have been sent back down.
people.subject: The moment: scrubbing the edge of a stone cistern, her wet hem dragging, she looks up with a glad smile, happy to have been sent back down. Face: most important, strong forearms bare below rolled sleeves, and a hem dark and dripping. It is a round, ruddy, cheerful face with bright, warm brown eyes, thick brows, a snub nose and a wide smile; her cheeks are chapped pink, and a smear of lime-wash whitens her forehead. Hair: black, in a plain bun tied with a cord, a short curl sticking out over each ear. Body: sturdy, strong-armed and rounded, kneeling on one knee beside the rim with her back flat, a sweeper's solid ease. Clothing: a plain undyed grey outer-gate robe of good cloth, wet and dark at the hem, a short black rain cape, and a black sash. Hands and objects: a stiff-bristled brush in the right hand; the left rests on the wet stone rim of the cistern. Slung across the back, the hilt of a plain slim jian with a round guard rises past the left shoulder, in a red-brown scabbard, the grip wrapped in rust-red cord, a copper guard. Background: a stone cistern full of still water, an old tower wall, a bronze chain hanging down. Light: soft grey light from the upper left; the water in the cistern throws a rippling reflection across the stone and across her cheek. Expression: glad and content, practical, the open, unbothered pleasure of someone who likes honest work and has no wish to be anywhere grander.

people.imagined: In a rain cap embroidered with the family crest, a size too bright, hands that have never carried a bag, expecting the old tower to remember.
people.subject: The moment: standing with an arrogant expectant air, a brightly embroidered rain cap on his head, hands clean and idle. Face: most important, a straw rain-cap bound with brilliant red-gold embroidery of a small bird crest, too bright for the grey of the Tower. A smooth, handsome, spoiled face; haughty, bright, brown eyes; arched brows; a fine nose; a pouting, expectant mouth. His skin is unblemished and his nails are neatly pared, and a faint gloss shines on his lips. Hair: black, glossy, in a neat topknot under the cap. Body: slim, upright, soft. He stands with his feet turned out, shoulders thrown back, and his hands held at his belt like a young lord at a feast. Clothing: a fine black oiled-silk rain cloak, an undyed grey robe of very fine cloth, a black sash. The grey robe is of finer cloth than the other disciples' and the cuffs are lined with a thin band of dark blue silk, and he wears soft felt shoes. Hands and objects: both hands empty and held in front of him, delicate and clean; at his feet, out of frame, someone else's bag. Slung across the back, past the right shoulder rises the hilt of a plain slim jian a little too fine for a plain sword, its grip wrapped in new blue-grey silk, a round guard of polished steel with an unnicked rim, a scabbard of fresh black lacquer without a scratch, and a stiff new family tassel. Background: a grey old tower gate, rain, a courier's blurred figure. Light: soft grey light from the upper left. The grey light finds the embroidery on the cap and makes the thread glint gold and red. Expression: haughty, expectant, innocent.

people.imagined: Humming to the cisterns, hunched, gap-toothed, setting a straw hat on a peg for each elder who moved east.
people.subject: The moment: in a stone doorway at the end of the day he sets a straw hat carefully on a wooden peg, humming to the cisterns, one hat for each elder who moved east. Face: most important, a hunched back and a gap-toothed, humming mouth. It is a very old, wrinkled, gentle face, brown and dry, with small, faded, kind eyes, thin white brows, a bulbous nose, and a mouth with two teeth, humming; tiny hairs sprout from the ears and nose, and a drop of water hangs at the tip of his nose. Hair: thin white wisps showing at the nape beneath a knit cap of undyed wool. Body: bent almost double, shrunken, the spine forward at nearly a right angle and the long arms hanging with swollen knuckles. Clothing: a plain, clean, undyed grey servant's robe of soft old cloth, a short black rain cape, and a rope belt. Hands and objects: a straw hat in his hands; a row of straw hats hangs on pegs along the wall behind him; a wet scrubbing brush lies at his feet. Background: a stone doorway, many straw hats on pegs, a cistern. Light: soft grey light from the upper left, falling from the doorway, a gleam of wet along the row of pegs. Expression: contented and humming, a faithful, unhurried peace in the half-closed eyes.

people.imagined: Hair in a boatman's knot, a faded rope burn across her palm, chosen the rain burial in her first week.
people.subject: The moment: standing straight by a boat rope, palm held open to show a faded rope burn. Face: most important, a pale, faded rope burn scar across her open palm held forward. A young, tanned, steady face; clear, brave, grey-brown eyes; strong, level brows; a short nose; a calm, closed mouth. Her lashes are short and dark and a small beauty spot sits at the corner of her left eye. Hair: black, tied in a boatman's knot high on the crown. Body: lean, strong, balanced. She stands with her feet planted in boatman's balance, knees slightly bent, as if the dock were moving. Clothing: a plain undyed grey outer-gate robe, a short black rain cape, a black sash, a rope belt. The plain grey robe is knotted up at the right hip and the sleeves are held with twine, and a wet-stained rope belt hangs loose. Hands and objects: the right palm open, rope burn plain; the left holds a coil of rope. Past the right shoulder rises the pale blue-corded hilt of a plain short slim sword slung on the back, its blue-black scabbard held by a plain strap, the blade of blue-grey steel. Background: a grey lake dock, a small boat, mist. Light: soft grey light from the upper left. A cool silver light plays on the water behind her and lights the pale line of the old burn. Expression: calm, resolute, unafraid.

people.imagined: Holding the salve pots on the stair, catching his breath, hands very clean.
people.subject: The moment: stopped on a stair, catching his breath, holding a tray of small salve pots in very clean hands. Face: most important, a big pale body and a round, flushed, breathless face, the hands spotless from the salves. It is a large, soft, pale face with flushed cheeks, gentle, dark, tired eyes, faint pale lashes and brows, a round nose, and an open, panting mouth with a chapped lower lip. Hair: dark and short, combed damp to the skull, a thin line of sweat running down by the ear. Body: big, soft and pale, the shoulders heaving with each breath, one hand on the rail, belly rounded and knees locked. Clothing: a plain undyed grey outer-gate robe, clean, a short black rain cape, a black sash, and a white cloth apron. Hands and objects: a wooden tray of small round salve pots held in very clean hands; the other hand grips the rail. Background: a grey stone stair, rain, an infirmary door at the top. Light: soft grey rain-light from the upper left, falling from above onto his flushed face and the tray's small pots. Expression: breathless and gentle, resigned, the patient look of a big man who knows the stair is long and means to climb it anyway.

people.imagined: At the storm forge bellows, no eyebrows at all, already working on a third attempt at burning them off.
people.subject: The moment: at the forge bellows, leaning in toward the fire with an eager face, eyebrows gone, already working on a third attempt. Face: most important, completely bare brow ridges, smooth skin where eyebrows should be, giving a startled look. It is a thin, bright, rosy face with wide, excited brown eyes, a snub nose, and an eager open mouth; the skin at his brows is pinker than the rest, and the singed fringe makes the forehead look high and startled. Hair: black and short, singed at the front, a small tuft of singed hair at the temple. Body: slight and wiry, knees bent and feet set wide, leaning on the bellows with his whole weight, thin arms taut. Clothing: a plain undyed grey outer-gate robe, scorched at the cuffs by the forge, a leather apron, and a black sash. Hands and objects: both hands on a bellows handle, blackened to the wrist, a damp cloth bound over one thumb. A plain straight double-edged sword with a faint warm copper tint at the edge, its grip wrapped in blistered scorched leather, a plain dark disc guard, and a scabbard of singed soft wood blackened along one edge is slung diagonally across the back, its hilt showing above the right shoulder. Background: an orange forge mouth, sparks and dark beams. Light: orange firelight from the right and below, burning white on his forehead and turning the smooth place where his eyebrows were a shiny pink. Expression: eager and bold, innocent, the face of a boy who has not yet learned that the fire can say no.

people.imagined: Casting the bronze cups new disciples wear at the neck, sleeves rolled, mould sand in her hair.
people.subject: The moment: pouring molten bronze into a small clay mould, her face intent and proud, casting the cups new disciples wear at the neck. Face: most important, grey mould sand speckled in her black hair, and strong arms bare to the elbow. It is a strong, square, sun-tanned face with focused, bright dark eyes, strong brows, a short nose and a tight mouth; a drop of sweat runs down by her ear and a tiny smear of bronze stains her upper lip. Hair: black, tied in a tail that is grey with sand, a loose strand stuck to her damp cheek. Body: sturdy and strong-armed, feet apart and elbows in, steadying the heavy ladle like a seasoned founder. Clothing: a plain undyed grey outer-gate robe of good cloth with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, a leather apron, and a black sash. Hands and objects: a small iron ladle with glowing bronze held over a clay mould in both hands. A plain long straight sword, its grip wrapped in cord the pale colour of casting sand, a cast bronze disc guard left rough with the mould seam still showing and a tiny stamped ring-mark of her own, and a scabbard of dark grey leather is slung diagonally across the back, its hilt showing above the left shoulder. Background: a foundry with a rack of finished small bronze cups, an orange glow. Light: a fierce orange glow from the molten bronze lighting the underside of her chin and the sand on her cheeks, with cooler grey from the right. Expression: focused and proud, careful, the held breath of a pour that must not be spoiled.

people.imagined: Looks about twelve, smells of wet gravel, a pebble behind each ear, picking rain-flower pebbles from the stream.
people.subject: The moment: crouched in a stream picking up a pebble, grinning, a pebble tucked behind each ear. Face: most important, a small pebble tucked behind each ear, one visible on each side of his head. A small, round, childlike face, wet and pink; large, curious, brown eyes; arched brows; a button nose; an open, gap-toothed grin. A smear of wet mud crosses his chin and nose, and a tiny chip is missing from one front tooth. Hair: black, wet, sticking up. Body: small, thin, child-sized. He crouches with his bare knees almost to his ears, a child's easy squat, and his wet toes grip the gravel. Clothing: a plain undyed grey outer-gate robe, wet to the knee, a short black rain cape, a black sash. The grey robe is too large and has been rolled at the sleeves three times, and its hem floats on the water. Hands and objects: a small pale flower-shaped pebble held in his wet palm; the other hand in the stream. Slung across the back, past the right shoulder rises the hilt of a plain short slim sword far too big for him, its grip wrapped in gravel-grey cord, a small plain round guard, a scabbard of pale mud-splashed goatskin dried hard, and a smooth pebble knotted into the cord loop. Background: a shallow stream with bright wet gravel, a mine hill, mist. Light: soft grey light from the upper left, bright on water. A glitter of sunlight dances on the stream and lights the wet pebbles like bright beads. Expression: eager, innocent, delighted.

people.imagined: A splinter of thunder-glass on a cord round his wrist; he means to show his Thunder at the Bell Test no matter what his aunt says.
people.subject: The moment: lifting a wrist to show a splinter of violet glass, with a determined, sly grin, meaning to show his Thunder at the Bell Test whatever his aunt says. Face: most important, a violet splinter of thunder-glass on a cord around his wrist, held up toward the viewer. It is a narrow, eager, tanned face with bright, daring dark eyes, thick straight brows, a sharp nose and a cocky grin; a scatter of freckles crosses the nose and a tiny cleft marks the chin. Hair: black and spiky, a violet cord tied through it. Body: slight and springy, bouncing on the balls of his feet with loose shoulders and chest out, a boy sure of himself. Clothing: a plain undyed grey outer-gate robe hitched at one shoulder, a short black rain cape, and a black sash tied with a violet cord. Hands and objects: the left wrist lifted with a thin cord and a jagged violet crystal splinter that glows faintly; the right hand a fist. Slung across the back, past the left shoulder rises the hilt of a plain short slim sword with a faint violet shimmer along the steel, its grip wrapped in dark leather strips, a plain oval guard, a scabbard of black wood, and a small chip of smoky thunder-glass set in the pommel. Background: a rainy mine yard with a purple glow. Light: cool grey light from the upper left, with a violet shimmer playing across the crystal and tinting the skin of his wrist. Expression: daring and mischievous, the lifted chin and sly sideways glance of a boy daring the world to stop him.

people.imagined: Carrying the practice swords up the peak, wrestler's ear, bruises in three colours, a face that still hopes after four lost years.
people.subject: The moment: carrying a bundle of wooden practice swords up the peak over his shoulder, smiling hopefully through bruises, after four lost years. Face: most important, a crushed cauliflower wrestler's ear and bruises in three colours, purple, yellow and green, around one eye and cheek. It is a broad, battered, honest face with bright, hopeful brown eyes, one half closed in a bruise, thick brows, a flattened nose broken and set slightly to the left, and a wide hopeful smile with a half-healed split in the lower lip. Hair: black and cropped short, with a bald scar at the left temple and a rope fibre caught in it. Body: thick, strong and round-shouldered, stocky and bow-legged with thick forearms, leaning slightly to balance the weight of the swords. Clothing: a plain undyed grey outer-gate robe of good cloth, a short black rain cape, and a black sash. Hands and objects: a bundle of a dozen wooden practice swords on one shoulder, held by a rope. Background: a steep wet peak path in grey mist. Light: soft grey mist-light from the upper left, showing the bruises in their three colours. Expression: hopeful and good-humoured, undefeated, a smile that has lost four years of bouts and still turns up for the fifth.

people.imagined: Spring dawn at the outer gate, yet again at the bell frame, the eighty-sixth Kinh Trập he has sat. White beard, grey outer-disciple robe that his dignity does not quite fill. He remembers the one time the bell answered him, faintly, and listens as if for it.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn he sits upright on a low stool before a great bronze bell, his head tilted a little, listening with his whole face for an answer in his chest. Face: most important, a long, full white beard to the breastbone, combed and clean, above a plain outer-gate grey robe that hangs a little loose on him. A narrow, deeply lined old face, brown and soft as a dried apricot; pale, hopeful, watery blue-grey eyes; long white eyebrows drooping at the ends; a long straight nose; a thin mouth held in a dignified line, the lips just parted. Hair: thin white, drawn up into a tiny topknot with a plain wooden pin, wisps at the temples. Body: small, upright, thin as a rake, a straight back made with effort. Clothing: a plain undyed grey outer-gate robe of good cloth, neatly mended at one elbow with matching thread, a high plain collar, a short black oiled-silk rain cape folded square over the left shoulder, a black cloth belt tied in a flat knot. Hands and objects: both hands lie folded on his knees, knotted and spotted with age, the right thumb lifted; a plain wooden practice sword leans on the stool beside him. Background: the big dark bronze bell on its frame and a pale misty dawn, a blurred line of young people waiting. Light: cool, soft pearl-grey dawn light from the upper left, a faint gleam on the bronze. Expression: patient, hopeful, dignified, the look of a man who has waited eighty springs.

people.imagined: Late afternoon in the seat's kitchen, just before she puts the fire out for the night by the Night Rain rule. She has a poker at her hip and soot to her eyebrows. A servant waits for bread and she is deciding, by her mood, whether to give it.
people.subject: The moment: in a smoky kitchen at dusk she stands with fists on her hips, an iron poker pushed through her belt, glaring at someone waiting for bread, mood unreadable. Face: most important, soot blackens her eyebrows and the skin round them, so that her brows are smudged black bars over bright eyes, and her forearms, thick as loaves, are bare. A broad, red, shiny face with heavy cheeks; small, shrewd, bright, grey eyes; a short wide nose with a smut on the tip; a wide mouth set down at the corners, ready to scold. Hair: grey-streaked black, bundled under a floury white cloth tied at the nape, a few damp curls stuck to the temple. Body: short, wide, solid, built like a stove. Clothing: an undyed grey outer-gate robe, floury at the front, a sooty cloth apron of thick canvas tied twice round the waist, a short black oiled-silk rain cape pinned back, a black sash; sleeves rolled above the elbow. Hands and objects: a black iron poker thrust through the belt at her hip; both bare forearms thick and pink with soot to the wrist; behind her on a table, a round loaf of dark barley bread. Background: a dim stone kitchen, a big iron stove with the last red coals glowing, hanging pots, a ladle. Light: red-orange glow from the stove on the right, grey dusk from a small window on the left. Expression: formidable, moody, hard to read, one corner of the mouth twitching.

people.imagined: A road at dusk. He is exactly the sort of man no one remembers: ordinary brown coat, forgettable face. He carries sealed reeds without opening them and has learned the knots by their shape. He feels the weight of what he knows.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk on a road he stands looking at nothing in particular, one hand in his sleeve on a bundle of sealed reed tubes, so ordinary that the eye slides off him. Face: most important, an utterly plain face with nothing to hold the eye, and the one thing that does not fit is the hand slid into his sleeve, clutching a bundle of reeds. A medium, oval, tan face; small, mild, brown eyes that look slightly to one side; thin brown eyebrows; a short straight nose; a thin neutral mouth; no scar, no mole. Hair: ordinary brown, cut short and combed to the side, without ornament. Body: middle height, middle build, narrow shoulders, an unhurried walker's stance. Clothing: a plain brown cotton coat of common cut, worn but clean, buttoned to the neck, over grey trousers; no black rain cloak showing, only a small straw hat hung at the back on a cord; a leather strap across the chest. Hands and objects: the right hand pushed into the left sleeve, where three thin reed tubes sealed with knotted grass cord show at the cuff; the left hand rests on a satchel at his hip. Slung across the back, past the right shoulder rises the hilt of a plain narrow straight sword made to be forgotten, its grip wrapped in ordinary brown hemp, a plain bar guard, a scabbard of dull brown leather with no mark on it, and a seal-knot copied from a reed tied at the pommel. Background: a blurred dusk road between rice fields, a far lantern, a thin mist. Light: soft violet dusk light from the upper left, giving no shadow of note. Expression: bland, careful, faintly anxious, and forgettable.

people.imagined: The coast house at midday, fish accounts open. A fishwife's daughter, chattering without drawing breath, scales glittering in her hair. She folds some pages twice and does not ask why.
people.subject: The moment: at a desk at midday she chatters at the viewer with a bright animated face, hands flying, a pile of fish accounts beside her with several pages folded twice. Face: most important, silver fish scales stuck in her black hair and on her cheek glitter like sequins in the light, and her mouth is open mid-sentence. A round, pink, freckled face; large, bright, restless brown eyes; quick lifted brows; a snub nose; a wide mouth, forever talking, a gap between the front teeth. Hair: black, in a loose knot with two long strands falling, scales glittering all through it. Body: plump, small, gesturing, bouncing on her seat. Clothing: a plain undyed grey outer-gate robe, neat though fish-scaled at the cuffs, a short black oiled-silk rain cape on the chair back, a black sash; a blue cotton scarf at the neck. Hands and objects: both hands raised in a gesture, ink on the right forefinger; on the desk a stack of papers with the corner of several pages folded twice, and a clay cup of cold tea. A plain straight double-edged sword in a blue-black scabbard is slung diagonally across the back; its pewter guard and the grip wrapped in pale blue cord show above the left shoulder. Background: a bright coastal room, a window with gulls and masts, nets hung to dry. Light: bright salty sea light from the upper left, scales glinting. Expression: cheerful, chattering, innocently incurious.

people.imagined: The ferry landing at Thu Trì in the evening rain. Jug-eared boy with a rope sling over his shoulder, carrying a guest's bag, with an ear bent toward the guest for a copper a sentence. He is not proud of it.
people.subject: The moment: on a wet ferry landing at evening, he lugs a traveller's heavy bag up the steps, his head turned and big ear tilted toward the guest's murmured words. Face: most important, two large jug ears that stick out sideways from a narrow head, the left one cocked toward a voice, and a coil of ferry rope slung over one shoulder. A narrow, freckled, eager boy's face; wide, wary, light brown eyes; thin brows raised; a pointed nose; a thin mouth slightly open. Hair: short, mouse-brown, flat and wet, leaving the ears bare. Body: skinny, wiry, bent under the bag, a quick scuttle. Clothing: a plain undyed grey outer-gate robe, tucked up at the belt for the stairs, sleeves rolled, a short black oiled-silk rain cape dripping, a black sash; wet bare calves in rope-soled sandals. Hands and objects: both hands holding a big bundled bag of oiled cloth against his chest; a thick coil of ferry rope slung over his right shoulder; a single copper coin visible between two knuckles. A plain narrow straight sword with a faint damp sheen, its grip wrapped in unravelling ferry rope, a plain iron ring guard, a scabbard of river-tarred black wood with a splice in its sling, and a copper coin hung from the pommel by a thread is slung diagonally across the back, its hilt showing above the right shoulder. Background: a rain-dark landing, a lantern on a post, a ferry boat and grey water, a dim inn doorway. Light: warm yellow lantern light from the upper left, blue rain dusk behind. Expression: eager, furtive, listening.

people.imagined: Night Rain Market, writing the weights the weigher calls. A bone weight on a cord round her neck that she has never lost. She is quick, and was famous for a week when she caught a false stone.
people.subject: The moment: at a market stall at night she looks up from writing with a quick, bright, careful glance, a small white bone weight swinging at her throat; she writes the weights the weigher calls. Face: most important, a small white bone weight, polished and round, hanging on a red cord at her throat in front of the collar. It is a young, slim, quick, pale-brown face with sharp, bright, dark eyes that are always checking, narrow arched brows, a small neat nose, and a small mouth with a tight, pleased curl. Hair: black, in two neat buns pinned flat with bone pins. Body: slight and quick, straight-backed, perched on a stool. Clothing: a tidy plain undyed grey outer-gate robe, a short black oiled-silk rain cape, and a black sash with a small pouch; the cuffs are turned back and there is ink on the fingers of the right hand. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a fine brush lifted mid-stroke over a blank sheet; the left rests on the beam of a small brass balance. Background: the lanterns of the night market, blurred stalls, a rain-wet awning, a hanging row of weights. Light: warm gold lantern light from the upper left, a bright gleam on the polished bone. Expression: sharp and careful, proud, the small satisfied look of someone who once caught a false stone and has not forgotten how it felt.

people.imagined: On the burial boat at dawn on the lake, rowing posture straight, her gaze never blinking. Six generations of her family have poled this boat.
people.subject: The moment: standing in the stern of a long flat boat with a pole, she stares at the viewer without blinking, mist around her knees. Face: most important, an unblinking stare from wide, pale, steady eyes, never dropping, with the long arms and rower's straight spine below. A long, calm, solemn face, pale and cool; large, light grey eyes, the whites showing fully, perfectly still; thin straight brows; a long nose; a pale, closed mouth. Hair: black, plain, tied in a low tail with a white cord. Body: tall, long-armed, shoulders square, a rower's upright, slightly forward posture. Clothing: a plain undyed grey outer-gate robe, tucked and kilted for boat work, a short black oiled-silk rain cape, a black sash, a white mourning cord at the wrist; sleeves pushed above the elbow. Hands and objects: both long hands round a pale wooden boat pole, the palms thick with callus; behind her in the boat, a long bundle wrapped in white cloth lying along the floor. Slung across the back, past the left shoulder rises the hilt of a plain slim jian with a faint damp bloom on the steel, its grip wrapped in grey hemp, a round guard of dark tarnished bronze, and a scabbard of weathered grey bamboo bound with pale hemp like a punt pole. Background: a pale misty lake at dawn, withered lotus leaves, a faint shore. Light: cool pearl-grey dawn light from the upper left, a soft glow on the water. Expression: grave, calm, unblinking, a quiet duty.

people.imagined: On the cone at dawn, face lifted to the sky, a cloud-grey ribbon in her hair, reading the clouds a day early. She does not thank the goatherd who warns her.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a slope at dawn with her face turned up to the sky, eyes narrowed, reading the clouds. Face: most important, her face tipped straight up to the sky, throat stretched, with a cloud-grey ribbon streaming from her hair in the wind. A fine, sharp, brown face with high cheekbones; bright, narrowed, hazel eyes; thin brows lifted; a small straight nose; lips pursed in thought. Hair: black, in a long single plait with the pale grey silk ribbon wound through it and flying free. A tiny pinch of ash sits in the crown of the braid and the ribbon's end flutters like a small flag. Body: slim, springy, balanced on the slope. Clothing: a plain undyed grey outer-gate robe, short at the ankle for climbing, a short black oiled-silk rain cape snapping in the wind, a black sash; a coil of rope at the belt. Hands and objects: the right hand shading her brow; the left holds the cape closed at the throat; behind her, at the edge, a goat's horned head. Background: a bruised ash-grey sky of heavy clouds with a pale gap, the dark cone slope below. Light: cold silver light from the upper left, edges of cloud bright. The pale sun glances on the cloud edges and picks out a fine freckle pattern on her nose. Expression: intent, clever, a shade ungrateful.

people.imagined: Climbing to the water clock cistern in the dark, a full bucket on each shoulder on a carrying pole, silent step, never spilled a bucket.
people.subject: The moment: at night on a dark stair he climbs to the water-clock cistern carrying a pole across his shoulders with a full bucket at each end, utterly steady and silent. Face: most important, two wooden buckets brimming with water at the ends of a bent pole across his shoulders, not a drop spilled, and a calm, still face. It is a young, plain, quiet, brown, earnest face with steady dark eyes fixed ahead, level brows, a straight nose and a closed, patient mouth. Hair: black, tied in a plain knot, a few damp strands clinging to the nape and the cloth round the knot dark with sweat. Body: lean and sinewy, shoulders square under the pole, a night-walker's soft step. Clothing: a plain undyed grey outer-gate robe of good cloth with the sleeves tied back, soft cloth shoes, a short black oiled-silk rain cape folded over the pole, and a black sash. Hands and objects: both hands hold the pole ends steady beside his neck; the water in the buckets lies flat as glass with a point of lamplight in it. Background: a dark stone stair at night, a faint lamp on a wall far above, a single drip. Light: a thin cool light from a lamp at the upper left, deep blue shadow, a silver ripple of light across each bucket's surface, steady as a mirror. Expression: patient, calm and silent, a face that gives nothing away to the dark.

people.imagined: Tallying the salted meat and barley. An abacus bead strung on her braid, ink-black thumbs. Her master checks her sums against a second ledger in his sleeve that she has never seen.
people.subject: The moment: in a storeroom she tallies by flicking an abacus, an abacus bead hanging from the end of her braid, her thumbs black. Face: most important, a single wooden abacus bead tied to the tip of her long braid, swinging, and both thumbs black with ink to the first joint. A thin, serious, narrow face, pale; sharp, tired, dark eyes; fine straight brows; a thin nose; a tidy, closed mouth with a small crease between the brows. A little crease of worry stays between her brows, and a faint pencil line of ink smudges her left temple. Hair: black, in one long braid over her shoulder with the bead on the end. Body: slight, narrow-shouldered, bent over her work. Clothing: a plain undyed grey outer-gate robe, ink-grey cuffs, a short black oiled-silk rain cape on a hook, a black sash; a cloth apron. Hands and objects: the right thumb and finger flick beads on a small wooden abacus; the left hand's black thumb holds the page edge of a thick book. Background: stacked barrels of salted meat and sacks of barley, a hanging lamp. Light: warm lamplight from the upper left. A pale shaft of light from a high window touches the abacus beads and the ends of her braid. Expression: careful, dutiful, a little uneasy.

people.imagined: At the foot of the peak before the first storm, chin lifted toward the summit, unable to wait. He goes a little farther each year.
people.subject: The moment: standing at the foot of a steep peak path in a rising wind, chin raised, eyes fixed on the summit, bouncing on his toes. Face: most important, his chin thrust up at an angle toward the peak, the neck stretched, and a face lit with longing. A sharp, hungry, tanned face; bright, fixed, brown eyes; thick, upward-slanting brows; a strong nose; a tight, eager mouth. A line of sweat shines at the hairline and a small scar crosses his lip, from a fall on the first stretch. Hair: black, short and spiky, a rope-cord tied round the brow. Body: wiry, tense, on tiptoe, ready to run. Clothing: a plain undyed grey outer-gate robe tucked up for climbing, a short black oiled-silk rain cape flapping, a black sash, wrapped legs and rope-soled shoes. Hands and objects: both fists clenched at his sides; a coil of climbing rope at his shoulder; a scuffed practice sword on his back. A ring of scrapes marks the back of his right hand and a dark rust-brown stain marks the knuckles. Background: a very steep dark peak with cloud wreathing it, the first big drops of a storm. Light: grey-green storm light from the upper left, a bright cloud edge. Expression: Chin raised, eyes fixed on the summit, mouth a little open, impatient longing in the whole eager face.

people.imagined: A kitchen at night. Bald, silent cook sent from Xuyên Lâm Môn with the hostage, his ears seeming to listen on their own. Thirty years of being listened to and nothing heard.
people.subject: The moment: in a kitchen at night he stands very still with a ladle in hand, his head turned a little, ears seeming to listen. Face: most important, a completely bald, smooth, domed head and a pair of large, still ears, and burn-scarred cook's hands in the lower frame. A broad, plain, flat, impassive face, brown; small, calm, dark eyes; no eyebrows to speak of; a wide flat nose; a long closed mouth. Faint old burn marks speckle his jaw and neck, and his lashes are pale and short. Hair: none, the scalp shining. Body: thick-set, heavy-shouldered, utterly still. Clothing: a plain green tunic of heavy cotton, the colour of Xuyên Lâm, with a rolled collar and cloth buttons, a large white cook's apron, a brown cloth belt; sleeves rolled to the elbow. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a long wooden ladle; both forearms and hands, pocked and shiny with old burn scars, are lifted into the light. Background: a dim stone kitchen, a big iron pot steaming, a rack of bamboo steamers. Light: warm orange firelight from the lower left. A thin line of firelight touches the ladle's bowl and the sheen of his bald scalp. Expression: blank, silent, a listening stillness.

people.imagined: Folding a scrap of poem into her sleeve and humming when she thinks, an apricot seller's girl who knows the poem of the small tower by heart.
people.subject: The moment: standing alone under a rain-wet eave, humming softly with her head tilted, folding a small slip of paper into her sleeve. Face: most important, a tiny folded slip of paper going into the cuff of her sleeve, and a hummed tune on her lips. A small, round, dreamy face, pale pink; large, soft, far-off, dark eyes; fine low brows; a button nose; a small mouth shaped round a hum. A faint dusting of freckles crosses her nose and her lashes are long and dark. Hair: black, in two low plaits with apricot-orange threads. Body: small, slim, light. She stands with her feet together and her shoulders rounded slightly inward, a dreamer's loose posture. Clothing: a plain undyed grey outer-gate robe, soft and tidy, a short black oiled-silk rain cape, a black sash; a sprig of dried apricot blossom pinned at the collar. Hands and objects: the right fingers tucking the folded paper into the left sleeve; the left hand holds a small basket of apricots. A plain short slim sword, its grip wrapped in soft pale cotton strips, a small round iron guard, a scabbard of grey hide, and a tiny folded paper slip tucked under the cord binding is slung diagonally across the back, its hilt showing above the right shoulder. Background: a rain-wet eave, a stone yard, grey drizzle, an apricot tree blurred. Light: soft silvery light from the upper left. A thin silver line of rainlight runs along the eave and a drop gleams on her sleeve. Expression: dreamy, shy, content.

people.imagined: At the vault door in the evening, head cocked at a footstep, naming each elder by their tread. Ruin dust on his chin; he was born in the ruin of the old guard.
people.subject: The moment: standing guard beside a heavy iron door in the evening, his head cocked sharply toward the sound of steps far down the corridor, ready to name each elder by their tread. Face: most important, his head tilted hard to one side with the ear forward, mouth slightly open as he names a step, and a smudge of grey ruin dust on his chin; he was born in the ruin of the old guard. It is a young, narrow, solemn face with large, alert dark eyes looking aside, thin brows, a long nose, and parted lips; his lashes are long and still, and a thin line of dust-grey runs along the jaw to the ear. Hair: black and cropped short, a pale layer of ruin dust settled in it and giving it a grey tint. Body: slim and upright, rigid with attention. Clothing: a plain undyed grey outer-gate robe, dust-grey at the hem, a short black oiled-silk rain cape, a black sash, and a grey cloth wrapped round each fist. Hands and objects: both hands hold a plain wooden staff upright before him; the heavy iron door stands at his side. Background: a stone corridor, a single lamp, the long shadow of an approaching figure. Light: dim yellow lamplight from the upper left, a thin shaft of it lighting the side of his face turned toward the sound. Expression: alert and serious, wholly listening.

people.imagined: Walking down into the vaults with one hand on the wall, a thimble of lamp oil in her sleeve. She is afraid of the dark everywhere but here.
people.subject: The moment: walking down a dim stair with one hand flat on the stone wall, glancing at the dark behind her. Face: most important, her left hand flat on the wall and her wide, frightened eyes looking over her shoulder, a small clay oil flask in her other hand. A small, pale, anxious face; wide, round, dark, frightened eyes; thin, upturned brows; a small nose; a tight small mouth. Her lashes are wet and a small tear clings to the inner corner of one eye. Hair: black, in a single braid, tied with a bit of cord, a few loose strands. Body: small, thin, hunched, shrinking inward. Clothing: a plain undyed grey outer-gate robe, a short black oiled-silk rain cape, a black sash; a cloth apron spotted with oil. Hands and objects: the left hand flat against the wall; the right holds a small clay flask of lamp oil; in the cuff of her sleeve a thimble of oil shows. Background: a narrow stone stair going down into a vault lit with rows of lamps, a very dark corridor behind. Light: warm lamp glow from below and ahead, deep black behind. The far lamplight flickers in her wide eyes. Expression: afraid, resolute, small.

people.imagined: Carrying the grain tax up the road, calluses across both shoulders, thinking aloud about rice and how the ridge should eat it.
people.subject: The moment: trudging up the road with grain sacks on a shoulder-pole, talking aloud to herself about rice and how the ridge should eat it, mouth open. Face: most important, broad shoulders with a thick pad of callus visible where the neck of her robe is pulled aside, and a pole across them hung with grain sacks. It is a broad, plain, sunburnt face with honest, thoughtful brown eyes, strong straight brows, a wide nose, and a wide mouth in mid-speech; a scatter of small freckles crosses her cheeks and nose, and her lips are chapped from the road wind.
